```javascript:pages/records/edit/index.js
Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    form: {
      memberId: '',
      ruleId: '',
      type: 'reward',
      points: 0,
      remark: ''
    },
    members: [],
    rules: [],
    memberIndex: -1,
    ruleIndex: -1,
    submitting: false,
    showDeleteModal: false
  },

  onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      this.loadRecord(options.id)
    }
    this.loadMembers()
    this.loadRules()
  },

  async loadRecord(id) {
    try {
      const db = wx.cloud.database()
      const { data } = await db.collection('records').doc(id).get()
      
      this.setData({
        form: {
          memberId: data.memberId,
          ruleId: data.ruleId,
          type: data.type,
          points: data.points,
          remark: data.remark || ''
        }
      })

      // 设置选中的成员和规则索引
      this.setSelectedIndexes()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载记录失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  async loadMembers() {
    try {
      const db = wx.cloud.database()
      const { data } = await db.collection('members')
        .where({ isDeleted: false })
        .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
        .get()

      this.setData({ members: data })
      this.setSelectedIndexes()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载成员失败:', err)
    }
  },

  async loadRules() {
    try {
      const db = wx.cloud.database()
      const { data } = await db.collection('rules')
        .where({ isDeleted: false })
        .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
        .get()

      this.setData({ rules: data })
      this.setSelectedIndexes()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载规则失败:', err)
    }
  },

  setSelectedIndexes() {
    if (this.data.form.memberId && this.data.members.length) {
      const memberIndex = this.data.members.findIndex(m => m._id === this.data.form.memberId)
      if (memberIndex !== -1) {
        this.setData({ memberIndex })
      }
    }

    if (this.data.form.ruleId && this.data.rules.length) {
      const ruleIndex = this.data.rules.findIndex(r => r._id === this.data.form.ruleId)
      if (ruleIndex !== -1) {
        this.setData({ ruleIndex })
      }
    }
  },

  onMemberChange(e) {
    const index = e.detail.value
    const member = this.data.members[index]
    this.setData({
      memberIndex: index,
      'form.memberId': member._id
    })
  },

  onRuleChange(e) {
    const index = e.detail.value
    const rule = this.data.rules[index]
    this.setData({
      ruleIndex: index,
      'form.ruleId': rule._id,
      'form.type': rule.type,
      'form.points': rule.points
    })
  },

  async handleSubmit(e) {
    const { remark } = e.detail.value
    if (!this.data.form.memberId) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请选择成员',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }
    if (!this.data.form.ruleId) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请选择规则',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }

    this.setData({ submitting: true })
    try {
      const db = wx.cloud.database()
      const member = this.data.members[this.data.memberIndex]
      const rule = this.data.rules[this.data.ruleIndex]
      
      const data = {
        memberId: this.data.form.memberId,
        memberName: member.name,
        memberAvatar: member.avatarUrl,
        ruleId: this.data.form.ruleId,
        ruleName: rule.name,
        type: this.data.form.type,
        points: this.data.form.points,
        remark,
        updateTime: db.serverDate()
      }

      if (this.data.id) {
        await db.collection('records').doc(this.data.id).update({
          data
        })
      } else {
        data.createTime = db.serverDate()
        data.isDeleted = false
        await db.collection('records').add({
          data
        })

        // 更新规则使用次数
        await db.collection('rules').doc(rule._id).update({
          data: {
            usageCount: db.command.inc(1)
          }
        })
      }

      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('保存失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ submitting: false })
    }
  },

  showDeleteConfirm() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: true })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: false })
  },

  async handleDelete() {
    try {
      const db = wx.cloud.database()
      await db.collection('records').doc(this.data.id).update({
        data: {
          isDeleted: true,
          deleteTime: db.serverDate()
        }
      })

      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  }
})
```

```javascript:components/date-range/date-range.js
Component({
  properties: {
    startDate: {
      type: String,
      value: ''
    },
    endDate: {
      type: String,
      value: ''
    }
  },

  methods: {
    onStartDateChange(e) {
      const startDate = e.detail.value
      this.triggerEvent('change', {
        startDate,
        endDate: this.data.endDate
      })
    },

    onEndDateChange(e) {
      const endDate = e.detail.value
      this.triggerEvent('change', {
        startDate: this.data.startDate,
        endDate
      })
    }
  }
})
```

```xml:components/modal/modal.wxml
  <view class="content">

      >{{cancelText}}</button>
```

```css:components/modal/modal.wxss
.modal {

  color: var(--primary-color);
}
```

我们需要在 `nav-bar` 组件中添加 `onBack` 方法。让我们修改导航栏组件：

```diff:components/nav-bar/nav-bar.js
Component({
  properties: {
    title: String,
    fixed: {
      type: Boolean,
      value: false
    }
  },

  data: {
    statusBarHeight: 0
  },

  lifetimes: {
    attached() {
      const { statusBarHeight } = wx.getSystemInfoSync()
      this.setData({ statusBarHeight })
    }
  },

  methods: {
+   onBack() {
+     const pages = getCurrentPages()
+     if (pages.length > 1) {
+       wx.navigateBack()
+     } else {
+       wx.switchTab({
+         url: '/pages/index/index'
+       })
+     }
+   }
  }
})
```

这样我们就：
1. 添加了 `onBack` 方法来处理返回按钮点击事件
2. 如果有上一页，就返回上一页
3. 如果已经是第一页，就返回首页

```javascript:tests/members.test.js
    memberId = result._id

    expect(result.remark).toBe(testMember.remark)

      remark: '更新备注'
    }

    expect(member.name).toBe(updateData.name)
    expect(member.remark).toBe(updateData.remark)
```

然后创建成员服务层代码：

```javascript:services/members.js
const db = wx.cloud.database()
const collection = db.collection('family_members')

/**
 * 获取成员列表
 * @param {string} keyword 搜索关键词
 * @returns {Promise<Array>}
 */
async function getMemberList(keyword = '') {
  const query = {
    isDeleted: false
  }
  
  if (keyword) {
    query.name = db.RegExp({
      regexp: keyword,
      options: 'i'
    })
  }

  const { data } = await collection
    .where(query)
    .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
    .get()
  
  return data
}

/**
 * 添加成员
 * @param {Object} member 成员信息
 * @returns {Promise<Object>}
 */
async function addMember(member) {
  const data = {
    ...member,
    createTime: db.serverDate(),
    updateTime: db.serverDate(),
    isDeleted: false
  }
  const { _id } = await collection.add({ data })
  return {
    _id,
    ...data
  }
}

/**
 * 更新成员
 * @param {string} id 成员ID
 * @param {Object} data 更新数据
 * @returns {Promise<Object>}
 */
async function updateMember(id, data) {
  const result = await collection.doc(id).update({
    data: {
      ...data,
      updateTime: db.serverDate()
    }
  })
  return result
}

/**
 * 删除成员
 * @param {string} id 成员ID
 * @param {boolean} physical 是否物理删除
 * @returns {Promise<Object>}
 */
async function deleteMember(id, physical = false) {
  if (physical) {
    return await collection.doc(id).remove()
  }
  return await collection.doc(id).update({
    data: {
      isDeleted: true,
      deleteTime: db.serverDate()
    }
  })
}

module.exports = {
  getMemberList,
  addMember,
  updateMember,
  deleteMember
}
```

_**Assistant**_

啊，明白了。分包后需要修复引用路径和初始化加载。让我们修复成员列表页面：

```javascript:packages/members/pages/list/index.js
import { getMemberList, deleteMember } from '../../../services/members'

Page({
  data: {
    members: [],
    loading: false,
    keyword: '',
    showDeleteModal: false,
    deletingId: '',
    isEmpty: false
  },

  onLoad() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  onShow() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  onPullDownRefresh() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  async loadMembers() {
    if (this.data.loading) return
    this.setData({ loading: true })

    try {
      console.log('开始加载成员列表')
      const data = await getMemberList(this.data.keyword)
      console.log('获取到成员列表:', data)
      
      this.setData({ 
        members: data,
        isEmpty: !data || data.length === 0
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载成员失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ loading: false })
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh()
    }
  },

  onSearch(e) {
    this.setData({
      keyword: e.detail
    }, () => {
      this.loadMembers()
    })
  },

  addMember() {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '../edit/index'
    })
  },

  editMember(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `../edit/index?id=${id}`
    })
  },

  showDeleteConfirm(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    this.setData({ 
      showDeleteModal: true,
      deletingId: id
    })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({ 
      showDeleteModal: false,
      deletingId: ''
    })
  },

  async confirmDelete() {
    if (!this.data.deletingId) return
    
    try {
      await deleteMember(this.data.deletingId)

      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })

      this.hideDeleteModal()
      this.loadMembers()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  }
})
```

```javascript:packages/members/services/members.js
const db = wx.cloud.database()
const collection = db.collection('family_members')

/**
 * 获取成员列表
 */
async function getMemberList(keyword = '') {
  const query = {
    isDeleted: false
  }
  
  if (keyword) {
    query.name = db.RegExp({
      regexp: keyword,
      options: 'i'
    })
  }

  try {
    const { data } = await collection
      .where(query)
      .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
      .get()
    
    console.log('成员列表数据:', data)
    return data
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取成员列表失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 删除成员
 */
async function deleteMember(id, physical = false) {
  if (physical) {
    return await collection.doc(id).remove()
  }
  return await collection.doc(id).update({
    data: {
      isDeleted: true,
      deleteTime: db.serverDate()
    }
  })
}

module.exports = {
  getMemberList,
  deleteMember
}
```

这样我们就：
1. 将服务模块移到了分包内
2. 使用相对路径引用
3. 保持了相同的功能
4. 避免了跨包引用的问题

4. 编辑页面的 JS：
```javascript:packages/members/pages/edit/index.js
const { addMember, updateMember, deleteMember } = require('../../services/members')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    form: {
      name: '',
      remark: '',
      avatarUrl: ''
    },
    submitting: false,
    showDeleteModal: false
  },

  onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      this.loadMember(options.id)
    }
  },

  async loadMember(id) {
    try {
      const db = wx.cloud.database()
      const { data } = await db.collection('family_members').doc(id).get()
      
      this.setData({
        form: {
          name: data.name,
          remark: data.remark || '',
          avatarUrl: data.avatarUrl || ''
        }
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载成员信息失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  async chooseAvatar() {
    try {
      const { tempFilePaths } = await wx.chooseImage({
        count: 1,
        sizeType: ['compressed']
      })

      const filePath = tempFilePaths[0]
      const cloudPath = `avatars/${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(-6)}.${filePath.match(/\.(\w+)$/)[1]}`

      wx.showLoading({ title: '上传中...' })
      const { fileID } = await wx.cloud.uploadFile({
        cloudPath,
        filePath
      })

      this.setData({
        'form.avatarUrl': fileID
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('上传头像失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '上传失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      wx.hideLoading()
    }
  },

  async handleSubmit(e) {
    const { name, remark } = e.detail.value
    if (!name) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请输入姓名',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }

    this.setData({ submitting: true })
    try {
      const data = {
        name,
        remark,
        avatarUrl: this.data.form.avatarUrl
      }

      if (this.data.id) {
        await updateMember(this.data.id, data)
      } else {
        await addMember(data)
      }

      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('保存失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ submitting: false })
    }
  },

  showDeleteConfirm() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: true })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: false })
  },

  async handleDelete() {
    try {
      await deleteMember(this.data.id)

      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  }
})
```

这样我们就：
1. 创建了完整的成员编辑页面
2. 实现了添加、编辑、删除功能
3. 支持上传头像
4. 添加了表单验证
5. 优化了用户体验

```javascript:pages/members/list/index.js
const { getMemberList, deleteMember } = require('../../../services/members')

Page({
  data: {
    members: [],
    loading: false,
    keyword: '',
    showDeleteModal: false,
    deletingId: ''
  },

  onLoad() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  onShow() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  onPullDownRefresh() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  async loadMembers() {
    if (this.data.loading) return
    this.setData({ loading: true })

    try {
      const data = await getMemberList(this.data.keyword)
      this.setData({ 
        members: data,
        isEmpty: !data || data.length === 0
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载成员失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ loading: false })
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh()
    }
  },

  onSearch(e) {
    this.setData({
      keyword: e.detail
    }, () => {
      this.loadMembers()
    })
  },

  addMember() {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '../edit/index'
    })
  },

  editMember(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `../edit/index?id=${id}`
    })
  },

  showDeleteConfirm(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    this.setData({ 
      showDeleteModal: true,
      deletingId: id
    })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({ 
      showDeleteModal: false,
      deletingId: ''
    })
  },

  async confirmDelete() {
    if (!this.data.deletingId) return
    
    try {
      await deleteMember(this.data.deletingId)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      this.hideDeleteModal()
      this.loadMembers()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  }
})
```

2. 创建规则服务模块：

```javascript:services/rules.js
const db = wx.cloud.database()
const collection = db.collection('rules')

/**
 * 获取规则列表
 */
async function getRuleList(keyword = '') {
  const query = {
    isDeleted: false
  }
  
  if (keyword) {
    query.name = db.RegExp({
      regexp: keyword,
      options: 'i'
    })
  }

  try {
    const { data } = await collection
      .where(query)
      .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
      .get()
    
    return data
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取规则列表失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 添加规则
 */
async function addRule(rule) {
  const data = {
    ...rule,
    createTime: db.serverDate(),
    updateTime: db.serverDate(),
    isDeleted: false
  }
  const { _id } = await collection.add({ data })
  return {
    _id,
    ...data
  }
}

/**
 * 更新规则
 */
async function updateRule(id, data) {
  return await collection.doc(id).update({
    data: {
      ...data,
      updateTime: db.serverDate()
    }
  })
}

/**
 * 删除规则
 */
async function deleteRule(id, physical = false) {
  if (physical) {
    return await collection.doc(id).remove()
  }
  return await collection.doc(id).update({
    data: {
      isDeleted: true,
      deleteTime: db.serverDate()
    }
  })
}

module.exports = {
  getRuleList,
  addRule,
  updateRule,
  deleteRule
}
```

然后创建记录添加页面：

```javascript:pages/records/add/index.js
const { addRecord } = require('../../../services/records')
const { getMemberList } = require('../../../services/members')
const { getRuleList } = require('../../../services/rules')

Page({
  data: {
    form: {
      memberId: '',
      ruleId: '',
      type: 'reward',  // reward 或 penalty
      points: 0
    },
    members: [],
    rules: [],
    submitting: false
  },

  async onLoad() {
    this.loadMembers()
    this.loadRules()
  },

  async loadMembers() {
    try {
      const members = await getMemberList()
      this.setData({ members })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载成员失败:', err)
    }
  },

  async loadRules() {
    try {
      const rules = await getRuleList()
      this.setData({ rules })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载规则失败:', err)
    }
  },

  onMemberChange(e) {
    this.setData({
      'form.memberId': e.detail.value
    })
  },

  onRuleChange(e) {
    const ruleId = e.detail.value
    const rule = this.data.rules.find(r => r._id === ruleId)
    if (rule) {
      this.setData({
        'form.ruleId': ruleId,
        'form.type': rule.type,
        'form.points': rule.points
      })
    }
  },

  async handleSubmit() {
    const { form } = this.data
    if (!form.memberId) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请选择成员',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }
    if (!form.ruleId) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请选择规则',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }

    this.setData({ submitting: true })
    try {
      await addRecord(form)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '添加成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('添加失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '添加失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ submitting: false })
    }
  }
})
```

最后创建记录服务模块：

```javascript:services/records.js
const db = wx.cloud.database()
const collection = db.collection('point_records')

/**
 * 添加记录
 */
async function addRecord(record) {
  const data = {
    ...record,
    createTime: db.serverDate(),
    updateTime: db.serverDate(),
    isDeleted: false
  }
  const { _id } = await collection.add({ data })
  return {
    _id,
    ...data
  }
}

module.exports = {
  addRecord
}
```

4. 添加了记录服务模块

3. 添加逻辑：

```javascript:pages/rules/edit/index.js
const { addRule, updateRule } = require('../../../services/rules')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    form: {
      name: '',
      type: 'reward',
      points: ''
    },
    submitting: false
  },

  onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      this.loadRule(options.id)
    }
  },

  async loadRule(id) {
    try {
      const db = wx.cloud.database()
      const { data } = await db.collection('point_rules').doc(id).get()
      
      this.setData({
        form: {
          name: data.name,
          type: data.type,
          points: data.points
        }
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载规则失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  onTypeChange(e) {
    this.setData({
      'form.type': e.detail.value
    })
  },

  async handleSubmit() {
    const { form } = this.data
    if (!form.name) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请输入规则名称',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }
    if (!form.points) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请输入积分值',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }

    this.setData({ submitting: true })
    try {
      const data = {
        name: form.name,
        type: form.type,
        points: parseInt(form.points)
      }

      if (this.data.id) {
        await updateRule(this.data.id, data)
      } else {
        await addRule(data)
      }

      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('保存失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ submitting: false })
    }
  }
})
```

您好，出现 INVALID_ENV 错误通常意味着当前使用的环境 ID (envId) 不正确或无效。请按照以下步骤进行检查和解决：

确认环境 ID：

确认您在代码中使用的 envId 是否正确。可以在云开发控制台中查看您的环境 ID。
示例代码：
cloud.init({
  env: 'your-env-id' // 替换为您的实际环境 ID
});

检查环境状态：

登录 腾讯云云开发控制台，查看您的环境状态。
如果环境状态显示为“已隔离”，需要进行续费操作才能恢复使用。
环境初始化：

确保在初始化云开发环境时，显式指定了环境 ID，而不是使用默认的环境列表中的第一个环境。
示例代码：
cloud.init({
  env: 'your-env-id' // 显式指定环境 ID
});

```diff:services/rules.js
  const collection = db.collection('point_rules')

  /**

   */
  async function getRuleList(keyword = '') {
+   // 确保数据库已初始化

    }

  /**

+   }

    console.log('Adding rule:', rule)

  }

  /**
   * 更新规则
   */
  async function updateRule(id, data) {
+   if (!db) {
+     throw new Error('数据库未初始化')
+   }

    return await collection.doc(id).update({
      data: {
        ...data,
        updateTime: db.serverDate()
      }
    })
  }

  /**
   * 删除规则
   */
  async function deleteRule(id, physical = false) {
+   if (!db) {
+     throw new Error('数据库未初始化')
+   }

    if (physical) {
      return await collection.doc(id).remove()
    }
    return await collection.doc(id).update({
      data: {
        isDeleted: true,
        deleteTime: db.serverDate()
      }
    })
  }
```

```javascript:pages/test/test.js
Page({
  data: {
    testResults: []
  },

  onLoad() {
    this.runTests()
  },

  async runTests() {
    const tests = [
      this.testAddRule,
      this.testGetRules,
      this.testUpdateRule,
      this.testDeleteRule,
      this.testAddMember,
      this.testGetMembers
    ]

    const results = []
    for (const test of tests) {
      try {
        await test.call(this)
        results.push({
          name: test.name,
          status: 'success',
          message: '测试通过'
        })
      } catch (err) {
        results.push({
          name: test.name,
          status: 'fail',
          message: err.message
        })
      }
    }

    this.setData({ testResults: results })
  },

  async testAddRule() {
    const { addRule } = require('../../services/rules')
    const testRule = {
      name: '测试规则-' + Date.now(),
      type: 'reward',
      points: 10
    }
    const result = await addRule(testRule)
    if (!result._id) throw new Error('添加规则失败')
    this.testRuleId = result._id
  },

  async testGetRules() {
    const { getRuleList } = require('../../services/rules')
    const rules = await getRuleList()
    if (!Array.isArray(rules)) throw new Error('获取规则列表失败')
  },

  async testUpdateRule() {
    if (!this.testRuleId) throw new Error('没有可更新的规则')
    const { updateRule } = require('../../services/rules')
    await updateRule(this.testRuleId, {
      name: '更新的规则-' + Date.now()
    })
  },

  async testDeleteRule() {
    if (!this.testRuleId) throw new Error('没有可删除的规则')
    const { deleteRule } = require('../../services/rules')
    await deleteRule(this.testRuleId)
  },

  async testAddMember() {
    const { addMember } = require('../../services/members')
    const testMember = {
      name: '测试成员-' + Date.now(),
      avatar: '/images/default-avatar.png'
    }
    const result = await addMember(testMember)
    if (!result._id) throw new Error('添加成员失败')
    this.testMemberId = result._id
  },

  async testGetMembers() {
    const { getMemberList } = require('../../services/members')
    const members = await getMemberList()
    if (!Array.isArray(members)) throw new Error('获取成员列表失败')
  }
})
```

1. 修改 services/rules.js：

```diff:services/rules.js
const db = wx.cloud.database()
const collection = db.collection('point_rules')

/**
 * 获取规则列表
 */
async function getRuleList(keyword = '') {
  console.log('Getting rules with query:', { isDeleted: false, keyword })
  const query = {
    isDeleted: false
  }
  
  if (keyword) {
    query.name = db.RegExp({
      regexp: keyword,
      options: 'i'
    })
  }

  try {
    const { data } = await collection
      .where(query)
      .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
      .get()
    
    console.log('Got rules:', data)
    return data
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取规则列表失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 添加规则
 */
async function addRule(rule) {
  console.log('Adding rule:', rule)
  try {
    const data = {
      name: rule.name,
      type: rule.type,
      points: parseInt(rule.points),
      createTime: db.serverDate(),
      updateTime: db.serverDate(),
      isDeleted: false,
+     _openid: wx.cloud.getWXContext().OPENID || '',
+     status: 'active'
    }
    console.log('Adding data:', data)
    const res = await collection.add({ data })
    console.log('Added rule with id:', res._id)
    return {
      _id: res._id,
      ...data
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('添加规则失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 更新规则
 */
async function updateRule(id, data) {
  try {
    const updateData = {
      ...data,
      updateTime: db.serverDate()
    }
    console.log('Updating rule:', id, updateData)
    const res = await collection.doc(id).update({
      data: updateData
    })
    console.log('Updated rule:', res)
    return res
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('更新规则失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 删除规则
 */
async function deleteRule(id, physical = false) {
  try {
    if (physical) {
      return await collection.doc(id).remove()
    }
    return await collection.doc(id).update({
      data: {
        isDeleted: true,
        deleteTime: db.serverDate()
      }
    })
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('删除规则失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

module.exports = {
  getRuleList,
  addRule,
  updateRule,
  deleteRule
}
```

```diff:services/rules.js
const db = wx.cloud.database()
const collection = db.collection('point_rules')

/**
 * 获取规则列表
 */
async function getRuleList(keyword = '') {
  console.log('Getting rules with query:', { isDeleted: false, keyword })
  const query = {
    isDeleted: false
  }
  
  if (keyword) {
    query.name = db.RegExp({
      regexp: keyword,
      options: 'i'
    })
  }

  try {
    const { data } = await collection
      .where(query)
      .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
      .get()
    
    console.log('Got rules:', data)
    return data
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取规则列表失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 添加规则
 */

  console.log('Adding rule:', rule)
  try {
    const data = {
      name: rule.name,
      type: rule.type,
      points: parseInt(rule.points),
      createTime: db.serverDate(),
      updateTime: db.serverDate(),
      isDeleted: false,
-     _openid: wx.cloud.getWXContext().OPENID || '',

    console.log('Added rule with id:', res._id)
    return {
      _id: res._id,
      ...data
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('添加规则失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 更新规则
 */

  try {
    const updateData = {
      ...data,
      updateTime: db.serverDate()
    }
+   delete updateData._openid  // 防止修改 _openid
    console.log('Updating rule:', id, updateData)
    const res = await collection.doc(id).update({
      data: updateData
    })
    console.log('Updated rule:', res)
    return res
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('更新规则失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}
```

1. 首先创建日历组件：

```javascript:components/calendar/calendar.js
Component({
  properties: {
    value: {
      type: String,
      value: ''
    },
    placeholder: {
      type: String,
      value: '请选择日期'
    }
  },

  data: {
    show: false,
    date: ''
  },

  lifetimes: {
    attached() {
      if (this.properties.value) {
        this.setData({ date: this.properties.value })
      } else {
        // 默认当前日期
        const now = new Date()
        this.setData({ 
          date: this.formatDate(now)
        })
      }
    }
  },

  methods: {
    showPicker() {
      this.setData({ show: true })
    },

    onClose() {
      this.setData({ show: false })
    },

    onConfirm(e) {
      const date = this.formatDate(new Date(e.detail))
      this.setData({ 
        date,
        show: false
      })
      this.triggerEvent('change', date)
    },

    formatDate(date) {
      const year = date.getFullYear()
      const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
      const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
      return `${year}-${month}-${day}`
    }
  }
})
```

```wxml:components/calendar/calendar.wxml
    bindcancel="onClose"
    bindconfirm="onConfirm"

</view>
```

```javascript:components/calendar/calendar.js
        this.setData({

      this.triggerEvent('change', date)

    formatDate(date) {

      const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
```

1. 首先修改 services/members.js，添加获取当前用户孩子的方法：

```javascript:services/members.js
/**
 * 获取当前用户的孩子列表
 */
async function getMyChildren() {
  try {
    // 先获取当前用户
    const { data: [currentUser] } = await collection
      .where({
        _openid: wx.getStorageSync('openid'),
        isDeleted: false
      })
      .get()

    if (!currentUser) {
      throw new Error('未找到当前用户')
    }

    // 获取所有与当前用户有关系的成员
    const { data: members } = await collection
      .where({
        isDeleted: false,
        'relations.memberId': currentUser._id,
        'relations.relation': 'parent' // 当前用户是这些成员的家长
      })
      .get()

    return members
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取孩子列表失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}
```

2. 修改 services/records.js，添加获取孩子记录的方法：

```javascript:services/records.js
/**
 * 获取孩子的积分记录
 * @param {Array} childrenIds 孩子ID列表
 * @param {Object} options 查询选项
 */
async function getChildrenRecords(childrenIds, options = {}) {
  try {
    const query = {
      isDeleted: false,
      memberId: db.command.in(childrenIds)
    }

    // 添加时间范围查询
    if (options.startTime) {
      query.createTime = query.createTime || {}
      query.createTime = db.command.gte(options.startTime)
    }
    if (options.endTime) {
      query.createTime = query.createTime || {}
      query.createTime = db.command.lte(options.endTime)
    }

    const { data } = await collection
      .where(query)
      .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
      .get()

    return data
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取孩子记录失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}
```

```markdown:README.md
# 家庭积分管理小程序

一个用于管理家庭成员积分的微信小程序。

## 功能特性

- 成员管理（家长、孩子）
- 积分规则管理
- 积分记录管理
- 统计分析
- 基于角色的权限控制

## 技术栈

- 微信小程序原生开发
- 微信云开发
  - 云数据库
  - 云函数
  - 云存储

## 开发环境

- Node.js
- 微信开发者工具

## 项目结构

- /pages - 页面文件
- /components - 自定义组件
- /services - 业务服务
- /utils - 工具函数
- /cloudfunctions - 云函数

## 开始使用

1. 克隆项目
2. 安装依赖
3. 在微信开发者工具中导入项目
4. 开启云开发
5. 创建必要的数据库集合

## 数据模型

### 成员表 (family_members)
- 姓名
- 角色（爸爸/妈妈/孩子）
- 性别
- 家庭关系
- 积分

### 规则表 (point_rules)
- 规则名称
- 类型（奖励/惩罚）
- 分值

### 记录表 (point_records)
- 成员ID
- 规则ID
- 分值
- 类型
- 时间
```

3. 修改组件逻辑：

```javascript:components/calendar/calendar.js
Component({
  properties: {
    value: {
      type: String,
      value: ''
    },
    placeholder: {
      type: String,
      value: '请选择日期'
    }
  },

  data: {
    weekdays: ['日', '一', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六'],
    currentYear: new Date().getFullYear(),
    currentMonth: new Date().getMonth() + 1,
    selectedDate: '',
    days: []
  },

  lifetimes: {
    attached() {
      this.initCalendar()
      if (this.properties.value) {
        this.setData({ selectedDate: this.properties.value })
      }
    }
  },

  methods: {
    initCalendar() {
      const days = this.generateDays(this.data.currentYear, this.data.currentMonth - 1)
      this.setData({ days })
    },

    generateDays(year, month) {
      const days = []
      const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1)
      const lastDay = new Date(year, month + 1, 0)
      const today = new Date()
      
      // 获取上个月的天数
      const prevMonthDays = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate()
      
      // 添加上个月的日期
      for (let i = firstDay.getDay(); i > 0; i--) {
        const day = prevMonthDays - i + 1
        days.push({
          day,
          date: this.formatDate(new Date(year, month - 1, day)),
          type: 'other-month'
        })
      }
      
      // 添加当前月的日期
      for (let i = 1; i <= lastDay.getDate(); i++) {
        const date = new Date(year, month, i)
        days.push({
          day: i,
          date: this.formatDate(date),
          type: 'current-month',
          isToday: this.isSameDay(date, today),
          isSelected: this.data.selectedDate === this.formatDate(date)
        })
      }
      
      // 添加下个月的日期
      const remainingDays = 42 - days.length // 保持6行
      for (let i = 1; i <= remainingDays; i++) {
        days.push({
          day: i,
          date: this.formatDate(new Date(year, month + 1, i)),
          type: 'other-month'
        })
      }
      
      return days
    },

    onDayClick(e) {
      const { date } = e.currentTarget.dataset
      const days = this.data.days.map(day => ({
        ...day,
        isSelected: day.date === date
      }))
      
      this.setData({ 
        selectedDate: date,
        days
      })
      
      this.triggerEvent('change', date)
    },

    formatDate(date) {
      const year = date.getFullYear()
      const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
      const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
      return `${year}-${month}-${day}`
    },

    isSameDay(date1, date2) {
      return date1.getFullYear() === date2.getFullYear() &&
        date1.getMonth() === date2.getMonth() &&
        date1.getDate() === date2.getDate()
    }
  }
})
```

主要特点：
1. 台历风格的头部显示
2. 网格布局的日期显示
3. 突出显示当前日期
4. 选中日期高亮
5. 显示上下月份的日期
6. 保持6行固定高度
7. 添加简单的动画效果

2. 修改成员服务 services/members.js：

```javascript:services/members.js
const db = wx.cloud.database()
const collection = db.collection('family_members')

/**
 * 获取成员列表
 */
async function getMemberList(type = 'all') {
  try {
    const openid = wx.getStorageSync('openid')
    const query = { isDeleted: false }
    
    // 根据类型筛选
    if (type === 'children') {
      query.role = 'child'
    } else if (type === 'family') {
      query.role = db.command.in(['father', 'mother'])
    }

    const { data } = await collection
      .where(query)
      .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
      .get()

    return data
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取成员列表失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 生成邀请码
 */
async function createInvite() {
  try {
    const { result } = await wx.cloud.callFunction({
      name: 'createInvite'
    })
    return result
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('生成邀请码失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 通过邀请码加入家庭
 */
async function joinFamily(code) {
  try {
    const { result } = await wx.cloud.callFunction({
      name: 'joinFamily',
      data: { code }
    })
    return result
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('加入家庭失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

module.exports = {
  getMemberList,
  createInvite,
  joinFamily
}
```

```javascript:cloudfunctions/createInvite/index.js
  const { OPENID } = cloud.getWXContext()
```

4. 创建云函数 joinFamily：

```javascript:cloudfunctions/joinFamily/index.js
const cloud = require('wx-server-sdk')
cloud.init()

exports.main = async (event, context) => {
  const db = cloud.database()
  const { OPENID } = cloud.getWXContext()
  const { code } = event

  try {
    // 查询邀请码
    const { data: [invite] } = await db.collection('invites')
      .where({
        code,
        isUsed: false
      })
      .get()

    if (!invite) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: '邀请码无效或已使用'
      }
    }

    // 更新邀请码状态
    await db.collection('invites').doc(invite._id).update({
      data: {
        isUsed: true,
        usedBy: OPENID,
        useTime: db.serverDate()
      }
    })

    // 创建家庭关系
    await db.collection('family_members').add({
      data: {
        _openid: OPENID,
        createdBy: invite.createdBy,
        createTime: db.serverDate(),
        isDeleted: false
      }
    })

    return {
      success: true
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err)
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err
    }
  }
}
```

1. 创建孩子编辑页面的 JS 文件 pages/members/children/edit/index.js：

```javascript:pages/members/children/edit/index.js
const { addMember, getMember, updateMember, deleteMember } = require('../../../../services/members')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    form: {
      name: '',
      remark: '',
      avatarUrl: '',
      gender: 'male',
      role: 'child'
    },
    genders: [
      { value: 'male', label: '男' },
      { value: 'female', label: '女' }
    ],
    submitting: false,
    showDeleteModal: false
  },

  onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      this.loadMember(options.id)
    }
  },

  async loadMember(id) {
    try {
      const data = await getMember(id)
      this.setData({
        form: {
          name: data.name,
          remark: data.remark || '',
          avatarUrl: data.avatarUrl || '',
          gender: data.gender || 'male',
          role: 'child'
        }
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载成员信息失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  async chooseAvatar() {
    try {
      const { tempFilePaths } = await wx.chooseImage({
        count: 1,
        sizeType: ['compressed']
      })

      const filePath = tempFilePaths[0]
      const cloudPath = `avatars/${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(-6)}.${filePath.match(/\.(\w+)$/)[1]}`

      wx.showLoading({ title: '上传中...' })
      const { fileID } = await wx.cloud.uploadFile({
        cloudPath,
        filePath
      })

      this.setData({
        'form.avatarUrl': fileID
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('上传头像失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '上传失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      wx.hideLoading()
    }
  },

  onGenderChange(e) {
    this.setData({
      'form.gender': e.detail.value
    })
  },

  async handleSubmit(e) {
    const { name, remark } = e.detail.value
    if (!name) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请输入姓名',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }

    this.setData({ submitting: true })
    try {
      const data = {
        name,
        remark,
        avatarUrl: this.data.form.avatarUrl,
        gender: this.data.form.gender,
        role: 'child'
      }

      if (this.data.id) {
        await updateMember(this.data.id, data)
      } else {
        await addMember(data)
      }

      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('保存失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ submitting: false })
    }
  },

  showDeleteConfirm() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: true })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: false })
  },

  async handleDelete() {
    try {
      await deleteMember(this.data.id)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  }
})
```

2. 创建家人加入页面的 JS 文件 pages/members/family/join/index.js：

```javascript:pages/members/family/join/index.js
const { joinFamily } = require('../../../../services/members')

Page({
  data: {
    code: '',
    submitting: false
  },

  onCodeInput(e) {
    this.setData({
      code: e.detail.value.toUpperCase()
    })
  },

  async handleJoin() {
    if (!this.data.code) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请输入邀请码',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }

    this.setData({ submitting: true })
    try {
      const result = await joinFamily(this.data.code)
      if (result.success) {
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加入成功',
          icon: 'success'
        })
        setTimeout(() => {
          wx.navigateBack()
        }, 1500)
      } else {
        wx.showToast({
          title: result.error || '加入失败',
          icon: 'none'
        })
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加入失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加入失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ submitting: false })
    }
  }
})
```

```javascript:pages/members/list/index.js
Page({
  data: {
    activeTab: 'children',
    children: [],
    family: [],
    keyword: '',
    showDeleteModal: false,
    deletingId: '',
    showInviteModal: false,
    inviteCode: ''
  },

  onLoad() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  onShow() {
    // 每次显示页面时刷新数据
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  switchTab(e) {
    const tab = e.currentTarget.dataset.tab
    this.setData({ activeTab: tab })
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  async loadMembers() {
    const { getMemberList } = require('../../../services/members')
    try {
      const members = await getMemberList(this.data.activeTab)
      // 区分孩子和家人
      const children = members.filter(m => m.role === 'child')
      const family = members.filter(m => m.role === 'father' || m.role === 'mother')
      this.setData({ 
        children,
        family
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载成员列表失败:', err)
    }
  },

  addChild() {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/members/children/edit/index'
    })
  },

  editMember(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/members/children/edit/index?id=${id}`
    })
  },

  inviteFamily() {
    this.setData({
      showInviteModal: true
    })
  },

  hideInviteModal() {
    this.setData({
      showInviteModal: false
    })
  },

  async generateInviteCode() {
    try {
      const { createInvite } = require('../../../services/members')
      const { code } = await createInvite()
      this.setData({
        inviteCode: code
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('生成邀请码失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '生成失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  copyInviteCode() {
    wx.setClipboardData({
      data: this.data.inviteCode,
      success: () => {
        wx.showToast({
          title: '已复制',
          icon: 'success'
        })
      }
    })
  },

  showDeleteConfirm(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    this.setData({
      showDeleteModal: true,
      deletingId: id
    })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({
      showDeleteModal: false,
      deletingId: ''
    })
  },

  async confirmDelete() {
    if (!this.data.deletingId) return
    
    try {
      const { deleteMember } = require('../../../services/members')
      await deleteMember(this.data.deletingId)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      this.hideDeleteModal()
      this.loadMembers()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  onSearch(e) {
    this.setData({
      keyword: e.detail
    })
    this.loadMembers()
  }
})
```

```diff:services/members.js
  /**
   * 获取成员列表
   */
  async function getMemberList(type = 'all') {
    try {
      const openid = wx.getStorageSync('openid')
      const query = { 
        isDeleted: false,
+       _openid: openid  // 只获取当前用户创建的成员
      }
      
      // 根据类型筛选
      if (type === 'children') {
        query.role = 'child'
      } else if (type === 'family') {
        query.role = db.command.in(['father', 'mother'])
      }

      const { data } = await collection
        .where(query)
        .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
        .get()

      return data
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('获取成员列表失败:', err)
      throw err
    }
  }

  /**
   * 添加成员
   */
  async function addMember(member) {
    try {
      const data = {
        name: member.name,
        avatar: member.avatar || '/images/default-avatar.png',
        role: member.role || 'child',
        gender: member.gender || 'male',
        points: 0,
+       createdBy: wx.getStorageSync('openid'),  // 记录创建者
        createTime: db.serverDate(),
        updateTime: db.serverDate(),
        isDeleted: false
      }
      const res = await collection.add({ data })
      return {
        _id: res._id,
        ...data
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('添加成员失败:', err)
      throw err
    }
  }
```

```diff:pages/index/index.js
  async loadOverview() {
    if (this.data.loading) return
    this.setData({ loading: true })

    try {
      if (!this.data.children.length) {
        this.setData({
          overview: {
            totalPoints: 0,
            rewardCount: 0,
            penaltyCount: 0,
            records: []
          }
        })
        return
      }

      const childrenIds = this.data.children.map(child => child._id)
      const now = new Date()
      const startTime = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1) // 本月1号
      const endTime = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0) // 本月最后一天

      const { getChildrenRecords } = require('../../services/records')
      const records = await getChildrenRecords(childrenIds, {
        startTime,
        endTime
      })

      // 计算统计数据
      const overview = {
        totalPoints: 0,
        rewardCount: 0,
        penaltyCount: 0,
        records: records.slice(0, 5) // 只显示最近5条记录
      }

      records.forEach(record => {
        if (record.type === 'reward') {
          overview.totalPoints += record.points
          overview.rewardCount++
        } else {
          overview.totalPoints -= record.points
          overview.penaltyCount++
        }
      })

      this.setData({ 
        monthStats: {
          total: overview.rewardCount + overview.penaltyCount,
          totalPoints: overview.totalPoints,
          rewards: overview.rewardCount,
          penalties: overview.penaltyCount
        },
        recentRecords: overview.records.map(record => ({
          _id: record._id,
          memberName: this.data.children.find(c => c._id === record.memberId)?.name || '未知',
          memberAvatar: this.data.children.find(c => c._id === record.memberId)?.avatar || '/images/default-avatar.png',
          type: record.type,
          points: record.points,
          ruleName: record.ruleName,
          createTime: this.formatTime(record.createTime)
        }))
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载概览数据失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ loading: false })
    }
  }
```

```diff:services/records.js
  /**
   * 获取孩子们的积分记录

  async function getChildrenRecords(childrenIds, { startTime, endTime } = {}) {
    try {
      const query = {
        isDeleted: false,
        memberId: db.command.in(childrenIds)
      }

      if (startTime) {
        query.createTime = query.createTime || {}
        query.createTime = db.command.gte(startTime)
      }

      if (endTime) {
        query.createTime = query.createTime || {}
        query.createTime = db.command.lte(endTime)
      }

      const { data } = await collection
        .where(query)
        .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
        .get()

+     // 获取规则名称
+     const ruleIds = [...new Set(data.map(record => record.ruleId))]
+     const { data: rules } = await db.collection('rules')
+       .where({
+         _id: db.command.in(ruleIds)
+       })
+       .get()
+     
+     const ruleMap = rules.reduce((map, rule) => {
+       map[rule._id] = rule.name
+       return map
+     }, {})

+     return data.map(record => ({
+       ...record,
+       ruleName: ruleMap[record.ruleId] || '未知规则'
+     }))

      return data
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('获取积分记录失败:', err)
      throw err
    }
  }
```

2. 修改 pages/members/list/index.js：

```javascript:pages/members/list/index.js
const { getMemberList, deleteMember } = require('../../../services/members')

Page({
  data: {
    loading: false,
    keyword: '',
    showDeleteModal: false,
    deletingId: '',
    children: []
  },

  onLoad() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  onShow() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  onPullDownRefresh() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  async loadMembers() {
    try {
      this.setData({ loading: true })
      const children = await getMemberList('children')
      this.setData({ 
        children,
        loading: false
      })
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载宝贝列表失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ loading: false })
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh()
    }
  },

  onSearch(e) {
    this.setData({
      keyword: e.detail
    }, () => {
      this.loadMembers()
    })
  },

  addChild() {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/members/children/edit/index'
    })
  },

  editChild(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/members/children/edit/index?id=${id}`
    })
  },

  showDeleteConfirm(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    this.setData({ 
      showDeleteModal: true,
      deletingId: id
    })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({ 
      showDeleteModal: false,
      deletingId: ''
    })
  },

  async confirmDelete() {
    if (!this.data.deletingId) return
    
    try {
      await deleteMember(this.data.deletingId)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      this.hideDeleteModal()
      this.loadMembers()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  }
})
```

1. 移除了所有家人相关的代码
2. 修改了方法名称，如 addMember 改为 addChild
3. 修改了导航路径，指向新的编辑页面
4. 优化了错误处理和加载状态
5. 添加了下拉刷新的处理
6. 简化了页面结构，只保留宝贝列表相关内容

3. pages/members/list/index.js:
```javascript:pages/members/list/index.js
const { getMemberList, deleteMember } = require('../../../services/members')

Page({
  data: {
    loading: false,
    keyword: '',
    showDeleteModal: false,
    deletingId: '',
    children: []
  },

  onLoad() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  onShow() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  onPullDownRefresh() {
    this.loadMembers()
  },

  async loadMembers() {
    try {
      this.setData({ loading: true })
      const children = await getMemberList('children')
      this.setData({ 
        children,
        loading: false
      })
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载宝贝列表失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ loading: false })
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh()
    }
  },

  onSearch(e) {
    this.setData({
      keyword: e.detail
    }, () => {
      this.loadMembers()
    })
  },

  addChild() {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/members/children/edit/index'
    })
  },

  editChild(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/members/children/edit/index?id=${id}`
    })
  },

  showDeleteConfirm(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    this.setData({ 
      showDeleteModal: true,
      deletingId: id
    })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({ 
      showDeleteModal: false,
      deletingId: ''
    })
  },

  async confirmDelete() {
    if (!this.data.deletingId) return
    
    try {
      await deleteMember(this.data.deletingId)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      this.hideDeleteModal()
      this.loadMembers()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  }
})
```

2. 添加页面逻辑：

```javascript:pages/members/children/edit/index.js
const { addMember, getMember, updateMember, deleteMember } = require('../../../../services/members')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    form: {
      name: '',
      remark: '',
      avatarUrl: '',
      gender: 'male',
      role: 'child'
    },
    genders: [
      { value: 'male', label: '男' },
      { value: 'female', label: '女' }
    ],
    submitting: false,
    showDeleteModal: false
  },

  onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      this.loadMember()
    }
  },

  async loadMember() {
    try {
      const member = await getMember(this.data.id)
      this.setData({
        form: {
          name: member.name,
          remark: member.remark || '',
          avatarUrl: member.avatarUrl,
          gender: member.gender,
          role: member.role
        }
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载成员信息失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  chooseAvatar() {
    wx.chooseImage({
      count: 1,
      sizeType: ['compressed'],
      sourceType: ['album', 'camera'],
      success: (res) => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFilePaths[0]
        this.setData({
          'form.avatarUrl': tempFilePath
        })
      }
    })
  },

  onGenderChange(e) {
    this.setData({
      'form.gender': e.detail.value
    })
  },

  async handleSubmit(e) {
    const { name, remark } = e.detail.value
    if (!name) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请输入姓名',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }

    this.setData({ submitting: true })
    try {
      const data = {
        name,
        remark,
        avatarUrl: this.data.form.avatarUrl,
        gender: this.data.form.gender,
        role: 'child'
      }

      if (this.data.id) {
        await updateMember(this.data.id, data)
      } else {
        await addMember(data)
      }

      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('保存失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ submitting: false })
    }
  },

  showDeleteConfirm() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: true })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: false })
  },

  async handleDelete() {
    try {
      await deleteMember(this.data.id)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  }
})
```

```javascript:pages/members/children/edit/index.js
const { addMember, getMember, updateMember, deleteMember } = require('../../../../services/members')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    form: {
      name: '',
      remark: '',
      avatarUrl: '',
      gender: 'male',
      role: 'child'
    },
    genders: [
      { value: 'male', label: '男' },
      { value: 'female', label: '女' }
    ],
    submitting: false,
    showDeleteModal: false
  },

  onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      this.loadMember()
    }
  },

  async loadMember() {
    try {
      const member = await getMember(this.data.id)
      this.setData({
        form: {
          name: member.name,
          remark: member.remark || '',
          avatarUrl: member.avatarUrl,
          gender: member.gender,
          role: member.role
        }
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载成员信息失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  chooseAvatar() {
    wx.chooseImage({
      count: 1,
      sizeType: ['compressed'],
      sourceType: ['album', 'camera'],
      success: (res) => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFilePaths[0]
        this.setData({
          'form.avatarUrl': tempFilePath
        })
      }
    })
  },

  onGenderChange(e) {
    this.setData({
      'form.gender': e.detail.value
    })
  },

  async handleSubmit(e) {
    const { name, remark } = e.detail.value
    if (!name) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请输入姓名',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }

    this.setData({ submitting: true })
    try {
      const data = {
        name,
        remark,
        avatarUrl: this.data.form.avatarUrl,
        gender: this.data.form.gender,
        role: 'child'
      }

      if (this.data.id) {
        await updateMember(this.data.id, data)
      } else {
        await addMember(data)
      }

      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('保存失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ submitting: false })
    }
  },

  showDeleteConfirm() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: true })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: false })
  },

  async handleDelete() {
    try {
      await deleteMember(this.data.id)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  }
})
```

```javascript:pages/members/children/edit/index.js
    } finally {
```

3. 修改 pages/members/children/edit/index.js：

```javascript:pages/members/children/edit/index.js
const { addMember, getMember, updateMember, deleteMember } = require('../../../../services/members')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    form: {
      name: '',
      remark: '',
      avatarUrl: '',
      gender: 'male',
      role: 'child'
    },
    submitting: false,
    showDeleteModal: false
  },

  onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      this.loadMember()
    }
  },

  async loadMember() {
    try {
      const member = await getMember(this.data.id)
      this.setData({
        form: {
          name: member.name,
          remark: member.remark || '',
          avatarUrl: member.avatarUrl,
          gender: member.gender,
          role: member.role
        }
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载成员信息失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  chooseAvatar() {
    wx.chooseMedia({
      count: 1,
      mediaType: ['image'],
      sourceType: ['album', 'camera'],
      camera: 'back',
      success: (res) => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].tempFilePath
        this.uploadAvatar(tempFilePath)
      }
    })
  },

  async uploadAvatar(filePath) {
    try {
      wx.showLoading({ title: '上传中...' })
      const cloudPath = `avatars/${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(-6)}.${filePath.match(/\.(\w+)$/)[1]}`
      const { fileID } = await wx.cloud.uploadFile({
        cloudPath,
        filePath
      })
      this.setData({
        'form.avatarUrl': fileID
      })
      wx.hideLoading()
      wx.showToast({
        title: '上传成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('上传头像失败:', err)
      wx.hideLoading()
      wx.showToast({
        title: '上传失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  onGenderSelect(e) {
    const gender = e.currentTarget.dataset.gender
    this.setData({
      'form.gender': gender
    })
  },

  async handleSubmit(e) {
    const { name, remark } = e.detail.value
    if (!name) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请输入姓名',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }

    this.setData({ submitting: true })
    try {
      const data = {
        name,
        remark,
        avatarUrl: this.data.form.avatarUrl,
        gender: this.data.form.gender,
        role: 'child'
      }

      if (this.data.id) {
        await updateMember(this.data.id, data)
      } else {
        await addMember(data)
      }

      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('保存失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ submitting: false })
    }
  },

  showDeleteConfirm() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: true })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: false })
  },

  async handleDelete() {
    try {
      await deleteMember(this.data.id)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  }
})
```

### **家庭积分刮刮卡功能实现方案**

---

#### **一、功能模块设计**
##### **1. 刮刮卡管理后台（家长端）**
- **创建刮刮卡**：  
  - **基础设置**：  
    - 奖品名称（如“周末电影票”）、奖品类型（实物/虚拟）、所需积分（如50分）。  
    - 中奖概率（如30%）、奖品库存（如10份）。  
  - **高级设置**：  
    - 有效期（截止日期）、奖品封面图（支持上传或选择模板）。  
    - 自定义刮刮卡背景（可选）。  

- **奖品列表管理**：  
  - 查看所有刮刮卡状态（未开始/进行中/已结束）。  
  - 支持批量操作：上架/下架、修改库存、导出中奖记录。  

##### **2. 刮刮卡兑换与游戏界面（孩子端）**
- **兑换流程**：  
  1. 进入“积分商城” → 选择“刮刮卡”分类 → 查看可用刮刮卡。  
  2. 点击兑换按钮 → 确认扣除积分 → 进入刮刮卡游戏界面。  

- **刮卡交互**：  
  - **Canvas绘制**：  
    - 上层为灰色覆盖层（模拟刮卡涂层），底层显示奖品图片或文字。  
    - 通过触摸事件擦除涂层（模拟刮卡动作）。  
  - **中奖反馈**：  
    - 刮开面积≥50%时自动显示奖品结果（如“恭喜获得电影票！”）。  
    - 未中奖时显示鼓励文案（如“下次好运哦~”）。  

##### **3. 中奖记录与兑换处理**
- **用户端记录**：  
  - 在个人中心查看中奖历史，支持筛选（未兑换/已兑换）。  
  - 中奖后推送微信服务通知（家长需审核后发放奖品）。  

- **家长端处理**：  
  - 审核中奖请求：确认奖品发放后标记为“已兑换”。  
  - 手动补发或取消资格（如库存不足时）。  

---

#### **二、技术实现细节**
##### **1. 前端实现（微信小程序）**
- **Canvas刮卡效果**：  
  ```javascript
  // 初始化Canvas
  const ctx = wx.createCanvasContext('scratchCanvas');
  // 绘制覆盖层
  ctx.setFillStyle('#CCCCCC');
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasWidth, canvasHeight);
  ctx.draw();

  // 触摸事件处理
  let isScratching = false;
  canvas.onTouchStart(() => { isScratching = true; });
  canvas.onTouchMove((e) => {
    if (!isScratching) return;
    const x = e.touches[0].x;
    const y = e.touches[0].y;
    // 擦除圆形区域
    ctx.clearRect(x - 15, y - 15, 30, 30);
    ctx.draw(true);
  });
  ```

- **概率计算与奖品分配**：  
  ```javascript
  // 服务端伪代码（防止前端篡改）
  function determinePrize(scratchCardId) {
    const card = db.scratchCards.find(scratchCardId);
    const random = Math.random() * 100;
    if (random <= card.winRate && card.stock > 0) {
      card.stock -= 1;
      db.save(card);
      return { success: true, prize: card.prizeName };
    }
    return { success: false };
  }
  ```

##### **2. 后端逻辑（云开发）**
- **安全校验**：  
  - 兑换前校验用户积分是否充足，并发请求加锁防止重复兑换。  
- **数据存储**：  
  - 刮刮卡信息表：`scratchCards`（字段：id, prizeName, points, winRate, stock）。  
  - 中奖记录表：`prizeRecords`（字段：userId, cardId, status, createdAt）。  

---

#### **三、交互与视觉设计**
##### **1. 刮刮卡样式**
- **默认模板**：  
  - 背景：渐变金色 + 闪烁粒子动效（营造神秘感）。  
  - 覆盖层：磨砂质感灰色，刮开后露出底层的奖品图标或文字。  
- **自定义选项**：  
  - 家长可上传家庭照片作为刮刮卡背景（如“全家福刮刮卡”）。  

##### **2. 动效与反馈**
- **刮卡过程**：  
  - 触摸时显示粒子飞散效果，增强操作反馈。  
- **中奖提示**：  
  - 成功：金色礼花动画 + 音效。  
  - 失败：灰色烟雾动画 + 鼓励语音（“继续努力！”）。  

---

#### **四、异常场景处理**
1. **积分不足时兑换**：  
   - 弹窗提示“积分不足，快去完成任务吧！”，引导至任务页。  
2. **刮卡中途退出**：  
   - 记录刮卡进度，再次进入时恢复未刮状态，避免重复扣分。  
3. **奖品库存耗尽**：  
   - 自动下架刮刮卡，中奖结果强制返回“未中奖”。  

---

#### **五、用户价值与数据埋点**
- **核心价值**：  
  - 提升积分消耗趣味性，增强孩子参与动力。  
  - 通过随机性平衡高价值奖品成本（如低概率大奖）。  
- **数据监控**：  
  - 埋点：刮卡次数、中奖率、兑换完成率。  
  - 家长端报表：统计奖品发放成本与积分消耗趋势。  

---

通过将刮刮卡游戏与积分系统深度结合，既能丰富家庭互动形式，又能灵活控制奖励成本，最终实现“趣味激励+积分管理”的双重目标。

好的，让我们先创建刮刮卡功能所需的基础数据结构。我们需要创建两个主要的集合：刮刮卡和中奖记录。

1. 首先创建刮刮卡集合的云函数：

```javascript:cloudfunctions/createScratchCard/index.js
// 云函数入口文件
const cloud = require('wx-server-sdk')

cloud.init({
  env: cloud.DYNAMIC_CURRENT_ENV
})

const db = cloud.database()
const collection = db.collection('scratchCards')

/**
 * 刮刮卡集合结构:
 * {
 *   _id: String,          // 记录ID
 *   name: String,         // 奖品名称
 *   type: String,         // 奖品类型：'physical'(实物) / 'virtual'(虚拟)
 *   points: Number,       // 所需积分
 *   probability: Number,  // 中奖概率(0-100)
 *   stock: Number,        // 奖品库存
 *   image: String,        // 奖品图片
 *   background: String,   // 刮刮卡背景图
 *   startTime: Date,      // 开始时间
 *   endTime: Date,        // 结束时间
 *   status: String,       // 状态：'draft'(草稿) / 'active'(进行中) / 'ended'(已结束)
 *   createdBy: String,    // 创建者openid
 *   createTime: Date,     // 创建时间
 *   updateTime: Date      // 更新时间
 * }
 */

// 云函数入口函数
exports.main = async (event, context) => {
  const { OPENID } = cloud.getWXContext()
  const { name, type, points, probability, stock, image, background, startTime, endTime } = event

  try {
    const result = await collection.add({
      data: {
        name,
        type,
        points,
        probability,
        stock,
        image: image || '',
        background: background || '',
        startTime: new Date(startTime),
        endTime: new Date(endTime),
        status: 'draft',
        createdBy: OPENID,
        createTime: db.serverDate(),
        updateTime: db.serverDate()
      }
    })

    return {
      success: true,
      id: result._id
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('创建刮刮卡失败:', err)
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err
    }
  }
}
```

2. 创建中奖记录集合的云函数：

```javascript:cloudfunctions/createPrizeRecord/index.js
// 云函数入口文件
const cloud = require('wx-server-sdk')

cloud.init({
  env: cloud.DYNAMIC_CURRENT_ENV
})

const db = cloud.database()
const collection = db.collection('prizeRecords')

/**
 * 中奖记录集合结构:
 * {
 *   _id: String,          // 记录ID
 *   cardId: String,       // 刮刮卡ID
 *   userId: String,       // 用户openid
 *   points: Number,       // 消耗积分
 *   prize: {             // 奖品信息
 *     name: String,      // 奖品名称
 *     type: String,      // 奖品类型
 *     image: String      // 奖品图片
 *   },
 *   status: String,       // 状态：'pending'(待审核) / 'approved'(已通过) / 'rejected'(已拒绝) / 'completed'(已完成)
 *   reviewBy: String,     // 审核人openid
 *   reviewTime: Date,     // 审核时间
 *   reviewNote: String,   // 审核备注
 *   createTime: Date,     // 创建时间
 *   updateTime: Date      // 更新时间
 * }
 */

// 云函数入口函数
exports.main = async (event, context) => {
  const { OPENID } = cloud.getWXContext()
  const { cardId, points, prize } = event

  try {
    const result = await collection.add({
      data: {
        cardId,
        userId: OPENID,
        points,
        prize,
        status: 'pending',
        reviewBy: '',
        reviewTime: null,
        reviewNote: '',
        createTime: db.serverDate(),
        updateTime: db.serverDate()
      }
    })

    return {
      success: true,
      id: result._id
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('创建中奖记录失败:', err)
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err
    }
  }
}
```

3. 创建更新刮刮卡状态的云函数：

```javascript:cloudfunctions/updateScratchCard/index.js
// 云函数入口文件
const cloud = require('wx-server-sdk')

cloud.init({
  env: cloud.DYNAMIC_CURRENT_ENV
})

const db = cloud.database()
const collection = db.collection('scratchCards')

// 云函数入口函数
exports.main = async (event, context) => {
  const { OPENID } = cloud.getWXContext()
  const { id, status, stock } = event

  try {
    const card = await collection.doc(id).get()
    if (!card.data) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: '刮刮卡不存在'
      }
    }

    // 只允许创建者修改
    if (card.data.createdBy !== OPENID) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: '无权限修改'
      }
    }

    const updateData = {
      updateTime: db.serverDate()
    }

    if (status) {
      updateData.status = status
    }

    if (typeof stock === 'number') {
      updateData.stock = stock
    }

    await collection.doc(id).update({
      data: updateData
    })

    return {
      success: true
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('更新刮刮卡失败:', err)
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err
    }
  }
}
```

1. **刮刮卡集合**：

   - 状态管理：库存、开始/结束时间、状态等

2. **中奖记录集合**：
   - 用户信息：谁中奖、消耗积分

3. **主要功能**：

   - 更新刮刮卡状态

3. 添加权限控制云函数：

```javascript:cloudfunctions/checkUserRole/index.js
// 云函数入口文件
const cloud = require('wx-server-sdk')

cloud.init({
  env: cloud.DYNAMIC_CURRENT_ENV
})

const db = cloud.database()

/**
 * 检查用户角色和权限
 * roles: ['parent', 'child']
 */
exports.main = async (event, context) => {
  const { OPENID } = cloud.getWXContext()
  
  try {
    // 获取用户信息
    const user = await db.collection('users').doc(OPENID).get()
    if (!user.data) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: '用户不存在'
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      role: user.data.role,
      isParent: user.data.role === 'parent',
      isChild: user.data.role === 'child',
      familyId: user.data.familyId
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('检查用户角色失败:', err)
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err
    }
  }
}
```

```javascript:services/scratch.js
const { callFunction } = require('../utils/cloud')

/**
 * 刮刮卡相关服务
 */
const scratchService = {
  /**
   * 创建刮刮卡
   */
  async createCard(data) {
    return callFunction('createScratchCard', data)
  },

  /**
   * 获取刮刮卡列表

    return callFunction('getScratchCards', params)
  },

  /**
   * 获取刮刮卡详情

  async getCardDetail(id) {
    return callFunction('getScratchCard', { id })
  },

  /**
   * 更新刮刮卡

  async updateCard(id, data) {
    return callFunction('updateScratchCard', { id, ...data })
  },

  /**
   * 创建中奖记录
   */
  async createPrizeRecord(data) {
    return callFunction('createPrizeRecord', data)
  },

  /**
   * 获取中奖记录列表
   */
  async getPrizeRecords(params = {}) {
    return callFunction('getPrizeRecords', params)
  }
}

module.exports = scratchService
```

5. 添加权限中间件：

```javascript:utils/auth.js
const { callFunction } = require('./cloud')

/**
 * 权限检查中间件
 */
async function checkAuth(pageInstance, roles = ['parent']) {
  try {
    const { success, role, isParent, isChild } = await callFunction('checkUserRole')
    if (!success) {
      wx.showToast({
        title: '获取用户信息失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      return false
    }

    if (!roles.includes(role)) {
      wx.showToast({
        title: '无访问权限',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
      return false
    }

    // 注入权限信息到页面实例
    pageInstance.setData({
      userRole: role,
      isParent,
      isChild
    })

    return true
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('权限检查失败:', err)
    wx.showToast({
      title: '系统错误',
      icon: 'error'
    })
    return false
  }
}

module.exports = {
  checkAuth
}
```

3. 实现页面逻辑：

```javascript:pages/scratch/list/index.js
const { checkAuth } = require('../../../utils/auth')
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    loading: true,
    cards: [],
    showDeleteModal: false,
    deletingId: ''
  },

  async onLoad() {
    // 检查权限
    await checkAuth(this, ['parent', 'child'])
    this.loadCards()
  },

  onShow() {
    this.loadCards()
  },

  onPullDownRefresh() {
    this.loadCards()
  },

  async loadCards() {
    try {
      this.setData({ loading: true })
      const { data: cards } = await scratchService.getCardList()
      this.setData({ 
        cards,
        loading: false
      })
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载刮刮卡列表失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ loading: false })
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh()
    }
  },

  createCard() {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/scratch/create/index'
    })
  },

  onCardTap(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    if (this.data.isParent) {
      wx.navigateTo({
        url: `/pages/scratch/detail/index?id=${id}`
      })
    } else {
      wx.navigateTo({
        url: `/pages/scratch/play/index?id=${id}`
      })
    }
  },

  editCard(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/scratch/create/index?id=${id}`
    })
  },

  deleteCard(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    this.setData({ 
      showDeleteModal: true,
      deletingId: id
    })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({ 
      showDeleteModal: false,
      deletingId: ''
    })
  },

  async confirmDelete() {
    if (!this.data.deletingId) return
    
    try {
      await scratchService.updateCard(this.data.deletingId, {
        status: 'deleted'
      })
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      this.hideDeleteModal()
      this.loadCards()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  stopPropagation() {
    // 阻止事件冒泡
  }
})
```

让我们先实现创建刮刮卡页面。这个页面需要支持设置奖品信息、上传图片、设置概率等功能。

1. 创建页面的 WXML：

```wxml:pages/scratch/create/index.wxml
<view class="container">
  <form bindsubmit="handleSubmit">
    <!-- 基础信息 -->
    <view class="form-group">
      <view class="form-item">
        <text class="form-label">奖品名称</text>
        <input 
          class="form-input"
          name="name"
          value="{{form.name}}"
          placeholder="请输入奖品名称"
        />
      </view>

      <view class="form-item">
        <text class="form-label">奖品类型</text>
        <radio-group 
          class="type-group"
          bindchange="onTypeChange"
        >
          <label class="type-item {{form.type === 'physical' ? 'active' : ''}}">
            <radio value="physical" checked="{{form.type === 'physical'}}" />
            <text>实物奖品</text>
          </label>
          <label class="type-item {{form.type === 'virtual' ? 'active' : ''}}">
            <radio value="virtual" checked="{{form.type === 'virtual'}}" />
            <text>虚拟奖品</text>
          </label>
        </radio-group>
      </view>

      <view class="form-item">
        <text class="form-label">所需积分</text>
        <input 
          class="form-input"
          type="number"
          name="points"
          value="{{form.points}}"
          placeholder="请输入兑换所需积分"
        />
      </view>

      <view class="form-item">
        <text class="form-label">中奖概率 (0-100)</text>
        <slider
          class="probability-slider"
          min="0"
          max="100"
          value="{{form.probability}}"
          bindchange="onProbabilityChange"
          activeColor="#07c160"
          backgroundColor="#eee"
          block-size="24"
        />
        <text class="probability-value">{{form.probability}}%</text>
      </view>

      <view class="form-item">
        <text class="form-label">奖品库存</text>
        <input 
          class="form-input"
          type="number"
          name="stock"
          value="{{form.stock}}"
          placeholder="请输入奖品库存数量"
        />
      </view>
    </view>

    <!-- 图片设置 -->
    <view class="form-group">
      <view class="form-item">
        <text class="form-label">奖品图片</text>
        <view class="image-upload" bindtap="choosePrizeImage">
          <image 
            wx:if="{{form.image}}"
            class="preview-image"
            src="{{form.image}}"
            mode="aspectFill"
          />
          <view wx:else class="upload-placeholder">
            <text class="icon">+</text>
            <text>上传图片</text>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>

      <view class="form-item">
        <text class="form-label">背景图片（选填）</text>
        <view class="image-upload" bindtap="chooseBackgroundImage">
          <image 
            wx:if="{{form.background}}"
            class="preview-image"
            src="{{form.background}}"
            mode="aspectFill"
          />
          <view wx:else class="upload-placeholder">
            <text class="icon">+</text>
            <text>上传背景</text>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>

    <!-- 时间设置 -->
    <view class="form-group">
      <view class="form-item">
        <text class="form-label">开始时间</text>
        <picker
          mode="date"
          value="{{form.startTime}}"
          bindchange="onStartTimeChange"
        >
          <view class="picker">
            {{form.startTime || '请选择开始时间'}}
          </view>
        </picker>
      </view>

      <view class="form-item">
        <text class="form-label">结束时间</text>
        <picker
          mode="date"
          value="{{form.endTime}}"
          bindchange="onEndTimeChange"
        >
          <view class="picker">
            {{form.endTime || '请选择结束时间'}}
          </view>
        </picker>
      </view>
    </view>

    <!-- 底部按钮 -->
    <view class="footer">
      <button 
        class="submit-btn"
        type="primary"
        form-type="submit"
        loading="{{submitting}}"
      >保存</button>

      <button 
        wx:if="{{id && form.status === 'draft'}}"
        class="publish-btn"
        bindtap="publishCard"
      >发布</button>
    </view>
  </form>
</view>
```
