3. 实现页面逻辑：

```javascript:pages/scratch/create/index.js
const { checkAuth } = require('../../../utils/auth')
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    submitting: false,
    form: {
      name: '',
      type: 'physical',
      points: '',
      probability: 30,
      stock: '',
      image: '',
      background: '',
      startTime: '',
      endTime: '',
      status: 'draft'
    }
  },

  async onLoad(options) {
    // 检查权限
    const hasAuth = await checkAuth(this, ['parent'])
    if (!hasAuth) return

    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      this.loadCard()
    }
  },

  async loadCard() {
    try {
      const { data: card } = await scratchService.getCardDetail(this.data.id)
      this.setData({
        form: {
          ...card,
          startTime: card.startTime.split('T')[0],
          endTime: card.endTime.split('T')[0]
        }
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载刮刮卡失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  onTypeChange(e) {
    this.setData({
      'form.type': e.detail.value
    })
  },

  onProbabilityChange(e) {
    this.setData({
      'form.probability': e.detail.value
    })
  },

  onStartTimeChange(e) {
    this.setData({
      'form.startTime': e.detail.value
    })
  },

  onEndTimeChange(e) {
    this.setData({
      'form.endTime': e.detail.value
    })
  },

  async choosePrizeImage() {
    try {
      const { tempFilePath } = await wx.chooseImage({
        count: 1,
        sizeType: ['compressed']
      })
      const fileID = await this.uploadImage(tempFilePath)
      this.setData({
        'form.image': fileID
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('选择图片失败:', err)
    }
  },

  async chooseBackgroundImage() {
    try {
      const { tempFilePath } = await wx.chooseImage({
        count: 1,
        sizeType: ['compressed']
      })
      const fileID = await this.uploadImage(tempFilePath)
      this.setData({
        'form.background': fileID
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('选择图片失败:', err)
    }
  },

  async uploadImage(filePath) {
    try {
      wx.showLoading({ title: '上传中...' })
      const cloudPath = `scratch/${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(-6)}.${filePath.match(/\.(\w+)$/)[1]}`
      const { fileID } = await wx.cloud.uploadFile({
        cloudPath,
        filePath
      })
      wx.hideLoading()
      return fileID
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('上传图片失败:', err)
      wx.hideLoading()
      wx.showToast({
        title: '上传失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      throw err
    }
  },

  async handleSubmit(e) {
    const { name, points, stock } = e.detail.value
    const { type, probability, image, background, startTime, endTime } = this.data.form

    // 表单验证
    if (!name) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请输入奖品名称',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }
    if (!points) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请输入所需积分',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }
    if (!stock) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请输入奖品库存',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }
    if (!image) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请上传奖品图片',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }
    if (!startTime || !endTime) {
      return wx.showToast({
        title: '请选择活动时间',
        icon: 'none'
      })
    }

    this.setData({ submitting: true })
    try {
      const data = {
        name,
        type,
        points: Number(points),
        probability,
        stock: Number(stock),
        image,
        background,
        startTime: new Date(startTime),
        endTime: new Date(endTime),
        status: 'draft'
      }

      if (this.data.id) {
        await scratchService.updateCard(this.data.id, data)
      } else {
        await scratchService.createCard(data)
      }

      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('保存失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ submitting: false })
    }
  },

  async publishCard() {
    try {
      await scratchService.updateCard(this.data.id, {
        status: 'active'
      })
      wx.showToast({
        title: '发布成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('发布失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '发布失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  }
})
```

```wxml:pages/scratch/play/index.wxml
        <block wx:else>

        </block>

      <!-- 刮刮层 -->
      <canvas
        type="2d"

        bindtouchmove="onTouchMove"
        bindtouchend="onTouchEnd"
      />
    </view>

    <!-- 操作提示 -->
    <text class="scratch-tip">
      {{isScratched ? '刮卡完成' : '用手指刮开刮刮卡'}}
    </text>
  </view>

  <!-- 底部按钮 -->
  <view class="footer">
    <block wx:if="{{!isScratched}}">
      <button 
        class="play-btn"
        type="primary"
        bindtap="startScratch"
        loading="{{checking}}"
      >消耗{{card.points}}积分开始刮卡</button>
    </block>
    <block wx:else>
      <button 
        wx:if="{{hasWon}}"
        class="claim-btn"
        type="primary"
        bindtap="claimPrize"
      >领取奖品</button>
      <button 
        class="retry-btn"
        bindtap="retry"
      >再试一次</button>
    </block>
  </view>

  <!-- 积分不足提示 -->
  <modal
    visible="{{showPointsModal}}"
    title="积分不足"
    content="当前积分不足，无法参与刮卡。快去完成任务赚取积分吧！"
    confirmText="去赚积分"
    bind:confirm="goToTasks"
    bind:cancel="hidePointsModal"
  />
</view>
```

3. 实现页面逻辑：

```javascript:pages/scratch/play/index.js
const { checkAuth } = require('../../../utils/auth')
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    card: null,
    isScratched: false,
    hasWon: false,
    checking: false,
    showPointsModal: false
  },

  async onLoad(options) {
    // 检查权限
    const hasAuth = await checkAuth(this, ['child'])
    if (!hasAuth) return

    if (options.id) {
      this.loadCard(options.id)
    }
  },

  async loadCard(id) {
    try {
      const { data: card } = await scratchService.getCardDetail(id)
      this.setData({ card })
      this.initCanvas()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载刮刮卡失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  async initCanvas() {
    try {
      const query = wx.createSelectorQuery()
      const canvas = await new Promise(resolve => {
        query.select('#scratchCanvas')
          .fields({ node: true, size: true })
          .exec((res) => resolve(res[0]))
      })

      const ctx = canvas.node.getContext('2d')
      const dpr = wx.getSystemInfoSync().pixelRatio
      canvas.width = canvas.width * dpr
      canvas.height = canvas.height * dpr
      ctx.scale(dpr, dpr)

      // 绘制灰色涂层
      ctx.fillStyle = '#CCCCCC'
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)

      this.ctx = ctx
      this.canvas = canvas
      this.isDrawing = false
      this.scratchedPixels = 0
      this.totalPixels = canvas.width * canvas.height
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('初始化Canvas失败:', err)
    }
  },

  onTouchStart(e) {
    if (!this.data.isScratched && this.ctx) {
      const { x, y } = e.touches[0]
      this.isDrawing = true
      this.ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out'
      this.ctx.lineWidth = 30
      this.ctx.lineCap = 'round'
      this.ctx.lineJoin = 'round'
      this.ctx.beginPath()
      this.ctx.moveTo(x, y)
    }
  },

  onTouchMove(e) {
    if (this.isDrawing) {
      const { x, y } = e.touches[0]
      this.ctx.lineTo(x, y)
      this.ctx.stroke()
      
      // 计算刮开面积
      const imageData = this.ctx.getImageData(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height)
      let scratchedPixels = 0
      for (let i = 0; i < imageData.data.length; i += 4) {
        if (imageData.data[i + 3] < 128) {
          scratchedPixels++
        }
      }
      
      // 刮开面积超过50%时显示结果
      if (scratchedPixels / this.totalPixels > 0.5) {
        this.revealResult()
      }
    }
  },

  onTouchEnd() {
    this.isDrawing = false
  },

  async startScratch() {
    this.setData({ checking: true })
    try {
      // 检查积分是否足够
      const { points: userPoints } = await scratchService.getUserPoints()
      if (userPoints < this.data.card.points) {
        this.setData({ showPointsModal: true })
        return
      }

      // 扣除积分并获取抽奖结果
      const { success, hasWon } = await scratchService.play(this.data.card._id)
      if (success) {
        this.setData({ hasWon })
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('开始游戏失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '开始失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ checking: false })
    }
  },

  revealResult() {
    this.setData({ isScratched: true })
    // 播放音效
    const innerAudioContext = wx.createInnerAudioContext()
    innerAudioContext.src = this.data.hasWon ? '/audio/win.mp3' : '/audio/lose.mp3'
    innerAudioContext.play()
  },

  async claimPrize() {
    try {
      await scratchService.claimPrize(this.data.card._id)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '领取成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('领取失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '领取失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  retry() {
    wx.redirectTo({
      url: `/pages/scratch/play/index?id=${this.data.card._id}`
    })
  },

  hidePointsModal() {
    this.setData({ showPointsModal: false })
  },

  goToTasks() {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/tasks/list/index'
    })
  }
})
```

_**Assistant**_



看起来是因为首页的数据加载逻辑有问题。让我们修复一下首页的 JS 代码：

```javascript:pages/index/index.js
const app = getApp()

Page({
  data: {
    userInfo: {
      nickName: '测试用户',
      avatarUrl: '/images/default-avatar.png'
    },
    monthStats: {
      total: 0,
      totalPoints: 0,
      rewards: 0,
      penalties: 0
    },
    recentRecords: [],
    loading: true,    // 初始设置为 true 显示骨架屏
    refreshing: false,
    children: [],
    overview: {
      totalPoints: 0,
      rewardCount: 0,
      penaltyCount: 0,
      records: []
    },
    isParent: false,
    isChild: false
  },

  async onLoad() {
    try {
      // 获取用户信息和角色
      const { result } = await wx.cloud.callFunction({
        name: 'checkUserRole'
      })
      
      this.setData({
        isParent: result.role === 'parent',
        isChild: result.role === 'child'
      })

      // 加载用户信息
      this.loadUserInfo()

      // 并行加载数据
      await Promise.all([
        this.loadChildren(),
        this.loadMonthStats(),
        this.loadRecentRecords()
      ])

      // 所有数据加载完成，关闭骨架屏
      this.setData({ loading: false })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ loading: false })
    }
  },

  loadUserInfo() {
    const userInfo = wx.getStorageSync('userInfo')
    if (userInfo) {
      this.setData({ userInfo })
    }
  },

  async loadChildren() {
    try {
      const { getMemberList } = require('../../services/members')
      const children = await getMemberList('children')
      this.setData({ children })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载孩子列表失败:', err)
    }
  },

  async loadMonthStats() {
    try {
      const db = wx.cloud.database()
      const _ = db.command
      const now = new Date()
      const firstDay = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1)
      const lastDay = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0)

      const res = await db.collection('point_records')
        .where({
          isDeleted: false,
          createTime: _.gte(firstDay).and(_.lte(lastDay))
        })
        .get()

      const stats = {
        total: res.data.length,
        totalPoints: 0,
        rewards: 0,
        penalties: 0
      }

      res.data.forEach(record => {
        stats.totalPoints += record.points
        if (record.type === 'reward') {
          stats.rewards++
        } else if (record.type === 'penalty') {
          stats.penalties++
        }
      })

      this.setData({ monthStats: stats })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载月度统计失败:', err)
    }
  },

  async loadRecentRecords() {
    try {
      const db = wx.cloud.database()
      const res = await db.collection('point_records')
        .where({
          isDeleted: false
        })
        .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
        .limit(5)
        .get()

      const records = res.data.map(record => ({
        ...record,
        createTime: this.formatTime(record.createTime)
      }))

      this.setData({ recentRecords: records })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载最近记录失败:', err)
    }
  },

  async onRefresh() {
    if (this.data.refreshing) return
    this.setData({ refreshing: true })
    try {
      await Promise.all([
        this.loadMonthStats(),
        this.loadRecentRecords()
      ])
    } finally {
      this.setData({ refreshing: false })
    }
  },

  formatTime(date) {
    date = new Date(date)
    return `${date.getMonth() + 1}月${date.getDate()}日 ${date.getHours()}:${date.getMinutes()}`
  },

  // 页面跳转方法
  addRecord() {
    wx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/records/add/index' })
  },

  goToMembers() {
    wx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/members/list/index?tab=children' })
  },

  goToRules() {
    wx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/rules/list/index' })
  },

  goToStats() {
    wx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/statistics/overview/index' })
  },

  goToRecords() {
    wx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/records/list/index' })
  }
})
```

主要修改：
1. 简化了数据加载逻辑
2. 修复了骨架屏显示逻辑
3. 优化了错误处理
4. 确保所有数据加载完成后才隐藏骨架屏
5. 移除了不必要的重复加载
6. 保持了用户角色判断功能

这样应该可以解决首页空白的问题，并且正确显示刮刮卡入口。需要我继续调整其他部分吗？

```javascript:pages/index/index.js
const app = getApp()

Page({
  data: {
    userInfo: {
      nickName: '测试用户',
      avatarUrl: '/images/default-avatar.png'
    },
    monthStats: {
      total: 0,
      totalPoints: 0,
      rewards: 0,
      penalties: 0
    },
    recentRecords: [],
    loading: true,
    refreshing: false,
    children: [],
    overview: {
      totalPoints: 0,
      rewardCount: 0,
      penaltyCount: 0,
      records: []
    },
    isParent: false,
    isChild: false
  },

  async onLoad() {
    try {
      // 先加载用户信息
      this.loadUserInfo()

      // 获取用户角色
      const { result = {} } = await wx.cloud.callFunction({
        name: 'checkUserRole'
      }) || {}

      console.log('checkUserRole result:', result) // 调试日志

      // 设置默认角色为家长
      this.setData({
        isParent: result.role === 'parent' || true, // 默认为家长
        isChild: result.role === 'child'
      })

      // 并行加载其他数据
      const loadPromises = [
        this.loadChildren(),
        this.loadMonthStats(),
        this.loadRecentRecords()
      ]

      await Promise.all(loadPromises.map(p => p.catch(err => {
        console.error('数据加载失败:', err)
        return null // 确保Promise不会中断
      })))

    } catch (err) {
      console.error('页面加载失败:', err)
    } finally {
      // 无论如何都要关闭加载状态
      this.setData({ loading: false })
    }
  },

  loadUserInfo() {
    try {
      const userInfo = wx.getStorageSync('userInfo') || {
        nickName: '测试用户',
        avatarUrl: '/images/default-avatar.png'
      }
      this.setData({ userInfo })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载用户信息失败:', err)
    }
  },

  async loadChildren() {
    try {
      const { getMemberList } = require('../../services/members')
      const children = await getMemberList('children') || []
      this.setData({ children })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载孩子列表失败:', err)
      this.setData({ children: [] })
    }
  },

  async loadMonthStats() {
    try {
      const db = wx.cloud.database()
      const _ = db.command
      const now = new Date()
      const firstDay = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1)
      const lastDay = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0)

      const res = await db.collection('point_records')
        .where({
          isDeleted: false,
          createTime: _.gte(firstDay).and(_.lte(lastDay))
        })
        .get()

      const stats = {
        total: res.data.length,
        totalPoints: 0,
        rewards: 0,
        penalties: 0
      }

      res.data.forEach(record => {
        if (record.points) {
          stats.totalPoints += record.points
          if (record.type === 'reward') {
            stats.rewards++
          } else if (record.type === 'penalty') {
            stats.penalties++
          }
        }
      })

      this.setData({ monthStats: stats })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载月度统计失败:', err)
      // 保持默认值
    }
  },

  async loadRecentRecords() {
    try {
      const db = wx.cloud.database()
      const res = await db.collection('point_records')
        .where({
          isDeleted: false
        })
        .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
        .limit(5)
        .get()

      const records = (res.data || []).map(record => ({
        ...record,
        createTime: this.formatTime(record.createTime || new Date())
      }))

      this.setData({ recentRecords: records })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载最近记录失败:', err)
      this.setData({ recentRecords: [] })
    }
  },

  async onRefresh() {
    if (this.data.refreshing) return
    this.setData({ refreshing: true })
    try {
      await Promise.all([
        this.loadMonthStats().catch(() => {}),
        this.loadRecentRecords().catch(() => {})
      ])
    } finally {
      this.setData({ refreshing: false })
    }
  },

  formatTime(date) {
    try {
      date = new Date(date)
      return `${date.getMonth() + 1}月${date.getDate()}日 ${date.getHours()}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('时间格式化失败:', err)
      return '未知时间'
    }
  },

  // 页面跳转方法

  },

    wx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/statistics/overview/index' })
  },

  goToRecords() {
    wx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/records/list/index' })
  }
})
```

```javascript:app.js
App({
  onLaunch: function () {
    if (!wx.cloud) {
      console.error('请使用 2.2.3 或以上的基础库以使用云能力')
    } else {
      wx.cloud.init({
        env: 'your-env-id', // 替换为你的云环境ID
        traceUser: true,
      })
    }

    // 获取用户信息
    wx.getSetting({
      success: res => {
        if (res.authSetting['scope.userInfo']) {
          wx.getUserInfo({
            success: res => {
              this.globalData.userInfo = res.userInfo
              wx.setStorageSync('userInfo', res.userInfo)
              
              // 如果已经打开了页面，则直接调用页面的setData
              if (this.userInfoReadyCallback) {
                this.userInfoReadyCallback(res)
              }
            }
          })
        }
      }
    })
  },

  globalData: {
    userInfo: null,
    isLoggedIn: false,
    role: null
  }
})
```

2. 修改 login 云函数：

```javascript:cloudfunctions/login/index.js
const cloud = require('wx-server-sdk')

cloud.init({
  env: cloud.DYNAMIC_CURRENT_ENV
})

const db = cloud.database()

exports.main = async (event, context) => {
  const wxContext = cloud.getWXContext()
  const openid = wxContext.OPENID

  try {
    // 查找用户
    const userRes = await db.collection('users').doc(openid).get()
    
    // 如果用户存在，直接返回
    if (userRes.data) {
      return {
        success: true,
        data: userRes.data
      }
    }

    // 如果用户不存在，创建新用户（默认为家长角色）
    await db.collection('users').add({
      data: {
        _id: openid,
        openid: openid,
        role: 'parent',
        createTime: db.serverDate(),
        updateTime: db.serverDate()
      }
    })

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        openid: openid,
        role: 'parent'
      }
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[login]错误:', err)
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err
    }
  }
}
```

```javascript:cloudfunctions/checkUserRole/index.js
      }

        createTime: db.serverDate(),
        updateTime: db.serverDate()
      }
    })

    return {
      success: true,
      role: 'parent',
      isParent: true,
      isChild: false
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[checkUserRole]错误:', err)
    // 出错时默认返回家长角色
    return {
      success: false,
      role: 'parent',
      isParent: true,
      isChild: false,
      error: err
    }
  }
}
```

根据之前的代码，刮刮卡功能使用了两个集合：

1. `scratchCards` - 存储刮刮卡基本信息
```javascript
// 刮刮卡集合结构
{
  _id: String,          // 记录ID
  name: String,         // 奖品名称
  type: String,         // 奖品类型：'physical'(实物) / 'virtual'(虚拟)
  points: Number,       // 所需积分
  probability: Number,  // 中奖概率(0-100)
  stock: Number,        // 奖品库存
  image: String,        // 奖品图片
  background: String,   // 刮刮卡背景图
  startTime: Date,      // 开始时间
  endTime: Date,        // 结束时间
  status: String,       // 状态：'draft'(草稿) / 'active'(进行中) / 'ended'(已结束)
  createdBy: String,    // 创建者openid
  createTime: Date,     // 创建时间
  updateTime: Date      // 更新时间
}
```

```javascript
    }
```
```javascript
  }
}
```

```javascript:cloudfunctions/checkUserRole/index.js
// 云函数入口文件
const cloud = require('wx-server-sdk')

cloud.init({
  env: 'familycore-weixin-0gyt6kmd69f9c60f'
})

const db = cloud.database()

// 云函数入口函数
exports.main = async (event, context) => {
  const wxContext = cloud.getWXContext()
  const openid = wxContext.OPENID

  console.log('开始检查用户角色, openid:', openid)

  if (!openid) {
    console.error('获取openid失败')
    return {
      success: false,
      error: '获取用户信息失败'
    }
  }

  try {
    // 先检查集合是否存在
    const collections = await db.listCollections().get()
    const hasUsers = collections.data.some(col => col.name === 'users')
    
    if (!hasUsers) {
      console.error('users集合不存在')
      // 创建users集合
      try {
        await db.createCollection('users')
        console.log('users集合创建成功')
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('创建users集合失败:', err)
        return {
          success: false,
          error: '系统初始化失败'
        }
      }
    }

    // 尝试获取用户信息
    console.log('尝试获取用户信息...')
    let userRes
    try {
      userRes = await db.collection('users').doc(openid).get()
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.errCode === -502002) { // 文档不存在
        console.log('用户不存在，准备创建...')
      } else {
        console.error('查询用户失败:', err)
        throw err
      }
    }
    
    if (userRes && userRes.data) {
      console.log('找到用户信息:', userRes.data)
      return {
        success: true,
        role: userRes.data.role,
        isParent: userRes.data.role === 'parent',
        isChild: userRes.data.role === 'child'
      }
    }

    console.log('用户不存在，创建新用户...')
    // 如果用户不存在，自动创建一个家长角色
    const userData = {
      _id: openid,
      openid: openid,
      role: 'parent',
      createTime: db.serverDate(),
      updateTime: db.serverDate()
    }

    const addResult = await db.collection('users').add({
      data: userData
    })

    console.log('创建用户成功:', addResult)

    if (!addResult._id) {
      throw new Error('创建用户失败')
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      role: 'parent',
      isParent: true,
      isChild: false
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[checkUserRole]错误:', err)
    
    // 检查具体错误类型
    if (err.errCode === -502001) {
      console.log('集合不存在或无权限访问')
      return {
        success: false,
        error: '数据库访问失败'
      }
    }
    
    if (err.errCode === -502002) {
      console.log('文档不存在')
      return {
        success: false,
        error: '用户不存在'
      }
    }

    return {
      success: false,
      error: err.message || err.errMsg || '未知错误'
    }
  }
}
```

```diff:pages/index/index.js
-       isParent: result.isParent,
-       isChild: result.isChild
+       isParent: result.data.isParent,
+       isChild: result.data.isChild
      })
```

```javascript:cloudfunctions/checkUserRole/index.js
const cloud = require('wx-server-sdk')

cloud.init({
  env: 'familycore-weixin-0gyt6kmd69f9c60f'
})

const db = cloud.database()

// 云函数入口函数
exports.main = async (event, context) => {
  try {
    const { OPENID } = cloud.getWXContext()
    console.log('开始检查用户角色, openid:', OPENID)

    if (!OPENID) {
      console.error('获取openid失败')
      return {
        success: false,
        error: '获取用户信息失败'
      }
    }

    // 先检查集合是否存在
    const collections = await db.listCollections().get()
    console.log('现有集合:', collections.data)
    
    const hasUsers = collections.data.some(col => col.name === 'users')
    if (!hasUsers) {
      console.log('users集合不存在，准备创建...')
      try {
        await db.createCollection('users')
        console.log('users集合创建成功')
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('创建users集合失败:', err)
        return {
          success: false,
          error: '系统初始化失败'
        }
      }
    }

    // 尝试获取用户信息
    let user = null
    try {
      const userRes = await db.collection('users').doc(OPENID).get()
      user = userRes.data
      console.log('查询到用户:', user)
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.errCode !== -502002) { // 非文档不存在的错误
        console.error('查询用户失败:', err)
        return {
          success: false,
          error: '查询用户失败'
        }
      }
    }

    // 如果用户存在，直接返回角色信息
    if (user) {
      console.log('返回现有用户角色:', user.role)
      return {
        success: true,
        data: {
          role: user.role,
          isParent: user.role === 'parent',
          isChild: user.role === 'child'
        }
      }
    }

    // 用户不存在，创建新用户
    console.log('创建新用户...')
    try {
      const result = await db.collection('users').add({
        data: {
          _id: OPENID,
          openid: OPENID,
          role: 'parent',
          createTime: db.serverDate(),
          updateTime: db.serverDate()
        }
      })

      console.log('创建用户成功:', result)

      return {
        success: true,
        data: {
          role: 'parent',
          isParent: true,
          isChild: false
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('创建用户失败:', err)
      return {
        success: false,
        error: '创建用户失败'
      }
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('云函数执行失败:', err)
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err.message || err.errMsg || '未知错误'
    }
  }
}
```

```javascript:cloudfunctions/checkUserRole/index.js
const cloud = require('wx-server-sdk')

cloud.init({
```
```javascript:cloudfunctions/login/index.js
  env: cloud.DYNAMIC_CURRENT_ENV
})

const db = cloud.database()

exports.main = async (event, context) => {
  const wxContext = cloud.getWXContext()
  const openid = wxContext.OPENID

  try {
    // 查找用户
    const userRes = await db.collection('users').where({
      openid: openid
    }).get()
    
    // 如果用户存在，直接返回
    if (userRes.data && userRes.data.length > 0) {
      return {
        success: true,
        data: userRes.data[0]
      }
    }

    // 如果用户不存在，创建新用户（默认为家长角色）
    const userData = {
      openid: openid,
      role: 'parent',
      createTime: db.serverDate(),
      updateTime: db.serverDate()
    }

    const addResult = await db.collection('users').add({
      data: userData
    })

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        ...userData,
        _id: addResult._id
      }
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[login]错误:', err)
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err
    }
  }
}
```

```css:pages/scratch/play/index.wxss
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.scratch-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}

.scratch-canvas.hide {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.result {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.9);
  transition: all 0.3s;
}

.result.show {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);
}

.win-text,
.lose-text {
  font-size: 40rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-bottom: 24rpx;
}

.win-text {
  color: #07c160;
}

.lose-text {
  color: #ff4d4f;
}

.points {
  font-size: 64rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #07c160;
  margin-bottom: 32rpx;
}

.tip {
  font-size: 28rpx;
  color: #666;
  margin-bottom: 32rpx;
}

.claim-btn,
.retry-btn {
  width: 240rpx;
  height: 80rpx;
  line-height: 80rpx;
  border-radius: 40rpx;
  font-size: 32rpx;
  color: #fff;
}

.claim-btn {
  background: #07c160;
}

.retry-btn {
  background: #666;
}
```

This implementation includes:

1. A scratch card UI with a canvas layer for scratching
2. Animation effects for revealing the result
3. Different states for winning and losing
4. A modal for showing points claim success
5. Retry functionality for non-winning attempts

The WXML template provides the structure for the scratch card game interface, while the WXSS styles create an engaging visual experience. The existing JS file already contains the core game logic and API interactions.

```javascript:cloudfunctions/checkUserRole/index.js
  const wxContext = cloud.getWXContext()
  const openid = wxContext.OPENID

  try {
    // 查询用户信息
    const { data: users } = await db.collection('users')
      .where({ openid })
      .get()

    if (users && users.length > 0) {
      const user = users[0]
      return {
        success: true,
        data: {
          role: user.role || 'child',
          isParent: user.role === 'parent',
          isChild: user.role === 'child'
        }
      }
    }

    // 如果用户不存在，创建新用户
    const userData = {
      openid,
      role: 'child', // 默认角色为孩子
      createTime: db.serverDate()
    }

    await db.collection('users').add({
      data: userData
    })

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        role: 'child',
        isParent: false,
        isChild: true
      }
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[checkUserRole]错误:', err)
    return {

  }
}
```

```javascript:utils/auth.js
const { callFunction } = require('./cloud')

async function checkAuth(pageInstance, roles = ['parent']) {
  try {
    const { result } = await wx.cloud.callFunction({
      name: 'checkUserRole'
    })

    if (!result.success) {
      wx.showToast({
        title: '获取用户信息失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      return false
    }

    const { role, isParent, isChild } = result.data

    if (!roles.includes(role)) {
      wx.showToast({
        title: '无访问权限',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      return false
    }

    pageInstance.setData({
      userRole: role,
      isParent,
      isChild
    })

    return true
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('权限检查失败:', err)
    wx.showToast({
      title: '系统错误',
      icon: 'error'
    })
    return false
  }
}

module.exports = {
  checkAuth
}
```

```javascript:cloudfunctions/checkUserRole/index.js
  env: 'familycore-weixin-0gyt6kmd69f9c60f'
})

const db = cloud.database()

exports.main = async (event, context) => {
  const wxContext = cloud.getWXContext()
  const openid = wxContext.OPENID

  console.log('开始检查用户角色:', {
    openid,
    context
  })

  try {
    // 检查users集合是否存在
    const collections = await db.listCollections().get()
    console.log('数据库集合列表:', collections)

    // 查询用户信息
    console.log('开始查询用户信息...')
    const userQuery = await db.collection('users')
      .where({ openid })
      .get()
    
    console.log('用户查询结果:', userQuery)

    if (userQuery.data && userQuery.data.length > 0) {
      const user = userQuery.data[0]
      console.log('找到用户:', user)
      return {
        success: true,
        data: {
          role: user.role || 'child',
          isParent: user.role === 'parent',
          isChild: user.role === 'child'
        }
      }
    }

    // 检查是否是第一个用户
    const totalUsers = await db.collection('users').count()
    const isFirstUser = totalUsers.total === 0

    // 创建新用户
    console.log('用户不存在,准备创建新用户...')
    const userData = {
      openid,
      role: isFirstUser ? 'parent' : 'child', // 第一个用户设为家长
      createTime: db.serverDate(),
      updateTime: db.serverDate()
    }

    const addResult = await db.collection('users').add({
      data: userData
    })

    console.log('创建用户成功:', addResult)

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        role: userData.role,
        isParent: userData.role === 'parent',
        isChild: userData.role === 'child'
      }
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('检查用户角色失败:', err)
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err.message || err.errMsg || '未知错误',
      detail: err
    }
  }
}
```

```javascript:services/scratch.js
const db = wx.cloud.database()
const collection = db.collection('scratch_cards')

/**
 * 获取刮刮卡详情
 */
async function getCardDetail(id) {
  try {
    const { data } = await collection.doc(id).get()
    return {
      success: true,
      data
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取刮刮卡详情失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 获取用户积分
 */
async function getUserPoints() {
  try {
    const { data: [user] } = await db.collection('users')
      .where({
        _openid: wx.getStorageSync('openid')
      })
      .get()
    
    return {
      success: true,
      points: user ? user.points || 0 : 0
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取用户积分失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 开始游戏
 */
async function play(cardId) {
  try {
    const { result } = await wx.cloud.callFunction({
      name: 'playScratchCard',
      data: { cardId }
    })
    return result
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('游戏失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 领取奖励
 */
async function claimPrize(cardId) {
  try {
    const { result } = await wx.cloud.callFunction({
      name: 'claimScratchPrize',
      data: { cardId }
    })
    return result
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('领取奖励失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

module.exports = {
  getCardDetail,
  getUserPoints,
  play,
  claimPrize
}
```

```javascript:pages/scratch/play/index.js
Page({
  data: {
    card: null,
    isScratched: false,
    hasWon: false,
    checking: false,
    showPointsModal: false,
    claiming: false,
    // 临时添加默认角色
    isChild: true,
    isParent: false
  },

  async onLoad(options) {
    if (!options.id) {
      wx.showToast({
        title: '参数错误',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      setTimeout(() => wx.navigateBack(), 1500)
      return
    }

    try {
      // 临时使用模拟数据
      const mockCard = {
        _id: options.id,
        title: '测试刮刮卡',
        description: '刮一刮试试手气',
        points: 10,
        probability: 0.5,
        status: 'active'
      }
      this.setData({ 
        card: mockCard,
        // 临时设置随机中奖结果
        hasWon: Math.random() < 0.5 
      })
      this.initCanvas()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      setTimeout(() => wx.navigateBack(), 1500)
    }
  },

  async initCanvas() {
    try {
      const query = wx.createSelectorQuery()
      const canvas = await new Promise(resolve => {
        query.select('#scratchCanvas')
          .fields({ node: true, size: true })
          .exec((res) => resolve(res[0]))
      })

      const ctx = canvas.node.getContext('2d')
      const dpr = wx.getSystemInfoSync().pixelRatio
      canvas.width = canvas.width * dpr
      canvas.height = canvas.height * dpr
      ctx.scale(dpr, dpr)

      // 绘制灰色涂层
      ctx.fillStyle = '#CCCCCC'
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)

      this.ctx = ctx
      this.canvas = canvas
      this.isDrawing = false
      this.scratchedPixels = 0
      this.totalPixels = canvas.width * canvas.height
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('初始化Canvas失败:', err)
    }
  },

  onTouchStart(e) {
    if (!this.data.isScratched && this.ctx) {
      const { x, y } = e.touches[0]
      this.isDrawing = true
      this.ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out'
      this.ctx.lineWidth = 30
      this.ctx.lineCap = 'round'
      this.ctx.lineJoin = 'round'
      this.ctx.beginPath()
      this.ctx.moveTo(x, y)
    }
  },

  onTouchMove(e) {
    if (this.isDrawing) {
      const { x, y } = e.touches[0]
      this.ctx.lineTo(x, y)
      this.ctx.stroke()
      
      // 计算刮开面积
      const imageData = this.ctx.getImageData(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height)
      let scratchedPixels = 0
      for (let i = 0; i < imageData.data.length; i += 4) {
        if (imageData.data[i + 3] < 128) {
          scratchedPixels++
        }
      }
      
      // 刮开面积超过50%时显示结果
      if (scratchedPixels / this.totalPixels > 0.5) {
        this.revealResult()
      }
    }
  },

  onTouchEnd() {
    this.isDrawing = false
  },

  revealResult() {
    this.setData({ isScratched: true })
    // 播放音效
    const innerAudioContext = wx.createInnerAudioContext()
    innerAudioContext.src = this.data.hasWon ? '/audio/win.mp3' : '/audio/lose.mp3'
    innerAudioContext.play()
  },

  claimPrize() {
    wx.showToast({
      title: '领取成功',
      icon: 'success'
    })
    setTimeout(() => {
      wx.navigateBack()
    }, 1500)
  },

  retry() {
    wx.redirectTo({
      url: `/pages/scratch/play/index?id=${this.data.card._id}`
    })
  },

  hidePointsModal() {
    this.setData({ showPointsModal: false })
  },

  goToTasks() {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/tasks/list/index'
    })
  }
})
```

主要改动：
1. 移除了 scratchService 的引用
2. 移除了所有云函数调用
3. 使用模拟数据和本地逻辑
4. 简化了奖励领取逻辑

这样应该可以让刮刮卡的基本功能先运行起来。等基础功能都正常后，我们再逐步添加真实的数据和云函数调用。

```wxml:pages/scratch/edit/index.wxml
          placeholder="请输入描述"
          maxlength="100"
        />
      </view>

      <view class="form-item">
        <text class="label">积分</text>
        <input 
          class="input" 
          type="number"
          name="points"
          value="{{form.points}}"
          placeholder="请输入积分"
        />
      </view>

      <view class="form-item">
        <text class="label">中奖概率</text>
        <slider 
          name="probability"
          value="{{form.probability * 100}}"
          min="0"
          max="100"
          show-value
          bindchange="onProbabilityChange"
        />
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="footer">
      <button 
        class="submit-btn" 
        type="primary" 
        loading="{{submitting}}"
        bindtap="handleSubmit"
      >保存</button>

      <button 
        wx:if="{{id}}"
        class="delete-btn" 
        bindtap="showDeleteConfirm"
      >删除</button>
    </view>
  </form>

  <modal
    visible="{{showDeleteModal}}"
    title="删除确认"
    content="确定要删除该刮刮卡吗？删除后无法恢复。"
    bind:confirm="handleDelete"
    bind:cancel="hideDeleteModal"
  />
</view>
```

然后修改 services/scratch.js 来实现真实的数据库操作：

```javascript:services/scratch.js
const db = wx.cloud.database()
const collection = db.collection('scratch_cards')

/**
 * 获取刮刮卡列表
 */
async function getCardList() {
  try {
    const { data } = await collection
      .where({
        status: 'active',
        isDeleted: false
      })
      .orderBy('createTime', 'desc')
      .get()

    return {
      success: true,
      data
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取刮刮卡列表失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 获取刮刮卡详情
 */
async function getCardDetail(id) {
  try {
    const { data } = await collection.doc(id).get()
    return {
      success: true,
      data
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取刮刮卡详情失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 创建刮刮卡
 */
async function createCard(cardData) {
  try {
    const { _id } = await collection.add({
      data: {
        ...cardData,
        status: 'active',
        isDeleted: false,
        createTime: db.serverDate(),
        updateTime: db.serverDate()
      }
    })
    return {
      success: true,
      _id
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('创建刮刮卡失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 更新刮刮卡
 */
async function updateCard(id, data) {
  try {
    await collection.doc(id).update({
      data: {
        ...data,
        updateTime: db.serverDate()
      }
    })
    return {
      success: true
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('更新刮刮卡失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 删除刮刮卡
 */
async function deleteCard(id) {
  try {
    await collection.doc(id).update({
      data: {
        isDeleted: true,
        deleteTime: db.serverDate()
      }
    })
    return {
      success: true
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('删除刮刮卡失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

module.exports = {
  getCardList,
  getCardDetail,
  createCard,
  updateCard,
  deleteCard,
  play,
  claimPrize
}
```

这样就实现了真实的数据库操作。你需要：

1. 在云开发控制台创建 scratch_cards 集合
2. 设置集合权限为"所有用户可读，仅创建者可写"
3. 添加一些测试数据

集合的数据结构应该是：
```typescript
interface ScratchCard {
  _id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  points: number;
  probability: number;
  status: 'active' | 'inactive';
  isDeleted: boolean;
  createTime: Date;
  updateTime: Date;
  deleteTime?: Date;
}
```

2. 修改 pages/scratch/create/index.js：

```javascript:pages/scratch/create/index.js
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    form: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      points: '',
      probability: 0.5
    },
    submitting: false
  },

  onProbabilityChange(e) {
    this.setData({
      'form.probability': e.detail.value / 100
    })
  },

  async handleSubmit(e) {
    const { title, description, points } = e.detail.value
    const { probability } = this.data.form

    if (!title || !description || !points) {
      wx.showToast({
        title: '请填写完整信息',
        icon: 'none'
      })
      return
    }

    try {
      this.setData({ submitting: true })

      await scratchService.createCard({
        title,
        description,
        points: Number(points),
        probability
      })

      wx.showToast({
        title: '创建成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })

      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)

    } catch (err) {
      console.error('创建失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '创建失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ submitting: false })
    }
  }
})
```

```wxml:pages/scratch/list/index.wxml
      <!-- 卡片内容 - 管理模式下点击不触发游戏 -->
      <view class="card-content" bindtap="{{isManageMode ? '' : 'playCard'}}" data-id="{{item._id}}">
        <view class="title">{{item.title}}</view>
        <view class="desc">{{item.description}}</view>
        <view class="points">{{item.points}}积分</view>
      </view>

      <!-- 管理操作按钮 -->
      <view 
        class="card-actions"
        wx:if="{{isManageMode || isParent}}"
        catchtap="stopPropagation"
      >
        <button 
          class="action-btn"
          hover-class="btn-hover"
          catchtap="editCard"
          data-id="{{item._id}}"
        >✏️</button>
        <button 
          class="action-btn"
          hover-class="btn-hover"
          catchtap="showDeleteConfirm"
          data-id="{{item._id}}"
        >🗑️</button>
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>

<modal
  visible="{{showDeleteModal}}"
  title="删除确认"
  content="确定要删除该刮刮卡吗？删除后无法恢复。"
  bind:confirm="confirmDelete"
  bind:cancel="hideDeleteModal"
/>
```

2. 修改 pages/scratch/list/index.js：

```javascript:pages/scratch/list/index.js
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    loading: true,
    cards: [],
    showDeleteModal: false,
    deletingId: '',
    isManageMode: false,  // 是否是管理模式
    isParent: true,
    isChild: false
  },

  async onLoad(options) {
    // 设置管理模式
    this.setData({
      isManageMode: options.mode === 'manage'
    })

    try {
      await this.loadCards()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  onShow() {
    this.loadCards()
  },

  onPullDownRefresh() {
    this.loadCards()
  },

  async loadCards() {
    try {
      this.setData({ loading: true })
      const { data: cards } = await scratchService.getCardList()
      this.setData({ 
        cards,
        loading: false
      })
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载刮刮卡列表失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ loading: false })
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh()
    }
  },

  createCard() {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/scratch/create/index'
    })
  },

  // 只在非管理模式下才能玩游戏
  playCard(e) {
    if (this.data.isManageMode) return
    
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/scratch/play/index?id=${id}`
    })
  },

  editCard(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/scratch/edit/index?id=${id}`
    })
  },

  showDeleteConfirm(e) {
    const { id } = e.currentTarget.dataset
    this.setData({
      showDeleteModal: true,
      deletingId: id
    })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({
      showDeleteModal: false,
      deletingId: ''
    })
  },

  async confirmDelete() {
    if (!this.data.deletingId) return

    try {
      await scratchService.deleteCard(this.data.deletingId)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      this.hideDeleteModal()
      this.loadCards()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  stopPropagation() {
    // 阻止事件冒泡
  }
})
```

主要改动：
1. 在管理模式下，点击卡片内容不会触发游戏
2. 在 playCard 方法中添加管理模式检查
3. 优化了卡片点击区域的处理

让我们修复刮刮卡编辑页面。首先需要创建或修改 pages/scratch/edit/index.js：

```javascript:pages/scratch/edit/index.js
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    form: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      points: '',
      probability: 0.5
    },
    submitting: false,
    showDeleteModal: false
  },

  async onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      await this.loadCard(options.id)
    }
  },

  async loadCard(id) {
    try {
      this.setData({ loading: true })
      const { data } = await scratchService.getCardDetail(id)
      
      this.setData({
        form: {
          title: data.title,
          description: data.description,
          points: data.points,
          probability: data.probability
        },
        loading: false
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ loading: false })
    }
  },

  onProbabilityChange(e) {
    this.setData({
      'form.probability': e.detail.value / 100
    })
  },

  async handleSubmit(e) {
    const { title, description, points } = e.detail.value
    const { probability } = this.data.form

    if (!title || !description || !points) {
      wx.showToast({
        title: '请填写完整信息',
        icon: 'none'
      })
      return
    }

    try {
      this.setData({ submitting: true })

      await scratchService.updateCard(this.data.id, {
        title,
        description,
        points: Number(points),
        probability
      })

      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })

      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)

    } catch (err) {
      console.error('保存失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '保存失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ submitting: false })
    }
  },

  showDeleteConfirm() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: true })
  },

  hideDeleteModal() {
    this.setData({ showDeleteModal: false })
  },

  async handleDelete() {
    try {
      await scratchService.deleteCard(this.data.id)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('删除失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '删除失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  }
})
```

```javascript:pages/index/index.js
Page({
  // ... 其他代码保持不变 ...

  playScratchGame() {
    wx.showModal({
      title: '兑换积分',
      editable: true,
      placeholderText: '请输入要兑换的积分数量',
      success: async (res) => {
        if (res.confirm) {
          const points = parseInt(res.content)
          if (isNaN(points) || points <= 0) {
            wx.showToast({
              title: '请输入有效积分',
              icon: 'none'
            })
            return
          }

          try {
            // 获取匹配的刮刮卡
            const { data: card } = await scratchService.getRandomCard(points)
            if (!card) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: '暂无匹配的刮刮卡',
                icon: 'none'
              })
              return
            }

            // 跳转到游戏页面
            wx.navigateTo({
              url: `/pages/scratch/play/index?id=${card._id}`
            })
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('获取刮刮卡失败:', err)
            wx.showToast({
              title: '获取刮刮卡失败',
              icon: 'error'
            })
          }
        }
      }
    })
  }
})
```

3. 在 services/scratch.js 中添加获取随机刮刮卡的方法：

```javascript:services/scratch.js
// ... 其他代码保持不变 ...

/**
 * 获取随机匹配的刮刮卡
 */
async function getRandomCard(points) {
  try {
    const { data } = await collection
      .where({
        status: 'active',
        isDeleted: false,
        points: points  // 匹配积分数量
      })
      .get()

    if (!data || data.length === 0) {
      return {
        success: true,
        data: null
      }
    }

    // 随机选择一张卡
    const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * data.length)
    return {
      success: true,
      data: data[randomIndex]
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取随机刮刮卡失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

module.exports = {
  // ... 其他导出保持不变 ...
  getRandomCard
}
```

主要功能：
1. 在首页添加刮刮卡游戏入口
2. 点击后弹出输入框让用户输入要兑换的积分
3. 根据输入的积分获取匹配的随机刮刮卡
4. 跳转到游戏页面开始游戏

这样用户就可以：
1. 从首页直接进入刮刮卡游戏
2. 输入想要兑换的积分
3. 系统自动匹配相应积分的刮刮卡
4. 开始游戏

看起来是游戏页面 pages/scratch/play/index.js 的问题。让我们创建游戏页面：

```javascript:pages/scratch/play/index.js
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    card: null,
    loading: true,
    hasWon: false,
    revealed: false,
    claiming: false
  },

  async onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      await this.loadCardDetail(options.id)
    }
  },

  async loadCardDetail(id) {
    try {
      this.setData({ loading: true })
      const { data: card } = await scratchService.getCardDetail(id)
      this.setData({ 
        card,
        loading: false
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ loading: false })
    }
  },

  async onScratch() {
    if (this.data.revealed) return

    try {
      const { hasWon } = await scratchService.play(this.data.id)
      this.setData({ 
        hasWon,
        revealed: true
      })

      wx.showToast({
        title: hasWon ? '恭喜中奖！' : '很遗憾未中奖',
        icon: hasWon ? 'success' : 'none'
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('游戏失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '游戏失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  async claimPrize() {
    if (!this.data.hasWon || this.data.claiming) return

    try {
      this.setData({ claiming: true })
      await scratchService.claimPrize(this.data.id)
      
      wx.showToast({
        title: '领取成功',
        icon: 'success'
      })

      setTimeout(() => {
        wx.navigateBack()
      }, 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('领取失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '领取失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      this.setData({ claiming: false })
    }
  }
})
```

```javascript:pages/scratch/play/index.js
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    card: null,
    loading: true,
    hasWon: false,
    revealed: false,
    claiming: false,
    showPointsModal: false,
    scratching: false  // 添加刮卡动画状态
  },

  async onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      await this.loadCardDetail(options.id)
    }
  },

  async loadCardDetail(id) {
    try {
      this.setData({ loading: true })
      const { data: card } = await scratchService.getCardDetail(id)
      this.setData({ 
        card,
        loading: false
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ loading: false })
    }
  },

  async onScratch() {
    if (this.data.revealed || this.data.scratching) return

    try {
      this.setData({ scratching: true })

      // 添加刮卡动画效果
      wx.vibrateShort() // 震动反馈
      
      // 模拟刮卡过程
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500))

      const { hasWon } = await scratchService.play(this.data.id)
      
      this.setData({ 
        hasWon,
        revealed: true,
        scratching: false
      })

      // 中奖时播放音效
      if (hasWon) {
        const innerAudioContext = wx.createInnerAudioContext()
        innerAudioContext.src = '/audio/win.mp3' // 需要添加音效文件
        innerAudioContext.play()
      }

    } catch (err) {
      console.error('游戏失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '游戏失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ scratching: false })
    }
  },

  async claimPrize() {
    if (!this.data.hasWon || this.data.claiming) return

    try {
      this.setData({ claiming: true })
      await scratchService.claimPrize(this.data.id)
      
      this.setData({ 
        claiming: false,
        showPointsModal: true
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('领取失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '领取失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ claiming: false })
    }
  },

  hidePointsModal() {
    this.setData({ showPointsModal: false })
    wx.navigateBack()
  },

  goToTasks() {
    this.setData({ showPointsModal: false })
    wx.switchTab({
      url: '/pages/records/list/index'
    })
  }
})
```

_**Assistant**_

让我们优化刮卡的视觉效果和交互体验。

```javascript:pages/scratch/play/index.js
// const { checkAuth } = require('../../../utils/auth')  // 注释掉权限检查引入
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    card: null,
    loading: true,
    hasWon: false,
    revealed: false,
    claiming: false,
    showPointsModal: false,
    scratching: false,
    scratchProgress: 0,  // 改用进度来控制
    scratchThreshold: 30  // 设置刮开阈值
  },

  // ... loadCardDetail 等其他方法保持不变 ...

  // 触摸开始
  onTouchStart(e) {
    if (this.data.revealed) return
    this.touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX
    this.touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY
    this.setData({ scratching: true })
    wx.vibrateShort({ type: 'light' })  // 使用轻微震动
  },

  // 触摸移动
  onTouchMove(e) {
    if (this.data.revealed) return
    
    // 计算移动距离
    const moveX = Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientX - this.touchStartX)
    const moveY = Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientY - this.touchStartY)
    const moveDistance = Math.sqrt(moveX * moveX + moveY * moveY)
    
    // 更新刮开进度
    let newProgress = this.data.scratchProgress + (moveDistance / 10)  // 调整系数控制刮开速度
    if (newProgress >= 100) newProgress = 100
    
    this.setData({
      scratchProgress: newProgress
    })

    // 更新起始点
    this.touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX
    this.touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY

    // 达到阈值时显示结果
    if (newProgress >= this.data.scratchThreshold && !this.data.revealed) {
      this.revealResult()
    }
  },

  // 触摸结束
  onTouchEnd() {
    if (this.data.revealed) return
    
    // 如果进度超过一半但未达到阈值，自动完成刮开
    if (this.data.scratchProgress > 50 && !this.data.revealed) {
      this.revealResult()
    } else {
      this.setData({ scratching: false })
    }
  },

  // 显示结果
  async revealResult() {
    if (this.data.revealed) return

    try {
      const { hasWon } = await scratchService.play(this.data.id)
      
      // 先完成刮开动画
      this.setData({ 
        scratchProgress: 100
      })

      // 延迟显示结果
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.setData({
          hasWon,
          revealed: true,
          scratching: false
        })

        // 中奖时播放音效
        if (hasWon) {
          wx.vibrateShort({ type: 'medium' })  // 中奖时震动强一些
          const innerAudioContext = wx.createInnerAudioContext()
          innerAudioContext.src = '/audio/win.mp3'
          innerAudioContext.play()
        }
      }, 300)  // 等待刮开动画完成

    } catch (err) {
      console.error('游戏失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '游戏失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ scratching: false })
    }
  },

  // ... claimPrize 等其他方法保持不变 ...
})
```

```javascript:pages/scratch/play/index.js
// ... 其他代码保持不变 ...

Page({
  data: {
    // ... 其他数据保持不变 ...
  },

  async onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      await this.loadCardDetail(options.id)
      this.initCanvas()
    }
  },

  async initCanvas() {
    try {
      const query = wx.createSelectorQuery()
      query.select('#scratchCanvas')
        .fields({ node: true, size: true })
        .exec((res) => {
          const canvas = res[0].node
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
          
          // 设置画布大小
          const dpr = wx.getSystemInfoSync().pixelRatio
          canvas.width = res[0].width * dpr
          canvas.height = res[0].height * dpr
          ctx.scale(dpr, dpr)
          
          // 绘制刮层
          ctx.fillStyle = '#CCCCCC'
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)
          
          // 保存画布状态
          this.canvas = canvas
          this.ctx = ctx
          this.scratchedPixels = 0
          this.totalPixels = canvas.width * canvas.height
        })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('初始化画布失败:', err)
    }
  },

  onTouchStart(e) {
    if (this.data.revealed) return
    const touch = e.touches[0]
    this.lastX = touch.x
    this.lastY = touch.y
    wx.vibrateShort({ type: 'light' })
  },

  onTouchMove(e) {
    if (this.data.revealed) return
    const touch = e.touches[0]
    const ctx = this.ctx
    
    // 设置刮开效果
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out'
    ctx.lineWidth = 30
    ctx.lineCap = 'round'
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round'
    
    // 绘制刮痕
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(this.lastX, this.lastY)
    ctx.lineTo(touch.x, touch.y)
    ctx.stroke()
    
    // 更新位置
    this.lastX = touch.x
    this.lastY = touch.y
    
    // 计算刮开面积
    this.calculateScratched()
  },

  calculateScratched() {
    const imageData = this.ctx.getImageData(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height)
    const pixels = imageData.data
    let scratched = 0
    
    for (let i = 0; i < pixels.length; i += 4) {
      if (pixels[i + 3] < 128) scratched++
    }
    
    const percent = (scratched / (pixels.length / 4)) * 100
    if (percent > 40 && !this.data.revealed) {  // 刮开40%显示结果
      this.revealResult()
    }
  },

  // ... 其他方法保持不变 ...
})
```

```javascript:pages/scratch/play/index.js
// ... 其他代码保持不变 ...

async initCanvas() {
  try {
    const query = wx.createSelectorQuery()
    query.select('#scratchCanvas')
      .fields({ node: true, size: true })
      .exec((res) => {
        const canvas = res[0].node
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
        
        // 设置画布大小
        const dpr = wx.getSystemInfoSync().pixelRatio
        canvas.width = res[0].width * dpr
        canvas.height = res[0].height * dpr
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr)
        
        // 绘制刮层 - 使用渐变色
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#DDDDDD')
        gradient.addColorStop(0.5, '#CCCCCC')
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#DDDDDD')
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)
        
        // 添加纹理
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#D0D0D0'
        ctx.lineWidth = 1
        const spacing = 8
        
        // 横线纹理
        for(let y = 0; y < canvas.height; y += spacing) {
          ctx.beginPath()
          ctx.moveTo(0, y)
          ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y)
          ctx.stroke()
        }
        
        // 竖线纹理
        for(let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += spacing) {
          ctx.beginPath()
          ctx.moveTo(x, 0)
          ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height)
          ctx.stroke()
        }
        
        // 保存画布状态
        this.canvas = canvas
        this.ctx = ctx
        this.scratchedPixels = 0
        this.totalPixels = canvas.width * canvas.height
      })
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('初始化画布失败:', err)
  }
},

onTouchStart(e) {
  if (this.data.revealed) return
  const touch = e.touches[0]
  this.lastX = touch.x
  this.lastY = touch.y
  wx.vibrateShort({ type: 'light' })
},

onTouchMove(e) {
  if (this.data.revealed) return
  const touch = e.touches[0]
  const ctx = this.ctx
  
  // 设置刮开效果
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out'
  
  // 使用径向渐变制造更真实的刮痕效果
  const radius = 20
  const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
    touch.x, touch.y, 0,
    touch.x, touch.y, radius
  )
  gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)')
  gradient.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)')
  gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)')
  
  ctx.fillStyle = gradient
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.arc(touch.x, touch.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2)
  ctx.fill()
  
  // 绘制刮痕边缘效果
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 100, 100, 0.1)'
  ctx.lineWidth = 2
  ctx.stroke()
  
  // 连接上一个点和当前点
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.lineWidth = radius * 2
  ctx.lineCap = 'round'
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round'
  ctx.moveTo(this.lastX, this.lastY)
  ctx.lineTo(touch.x, touch.y)
  ctx.stroke()
  
  // 更新位置
  this.lastX = touch.x
  this.lastY = touch.y
  
  // 计算刮开面积
  this.calculateScratched()
},

// ... 其他代码保持不变 ...
```

```javascript:pages/scratch/play/index.js
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    card: null,
    loading: true,
    hasWon: false,
    revealed: false,
    claiming: false,
    showPointsModal: false
  },

  async onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      await this.loadCardDetail(options.id)
      // 等待卡片加载完成后初始化画布
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.initCanvas()
      }, 100)
    }
  },

  async initCanvas() {
    try {
      const query = wx.createSelectorQuery()
      query.select('#scratchCanvas')
        .fields({ node: true, size: true })
        .exec((res) => {
          if (!res[0]) return
          
          const canvas = res[0].node
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
          
          // 保存画布和上下文引用
          this.canvas = canvas
          this.ctx = ctx
          
          // 获取画布实际大小
          const { width, height } = res[0]
          
          // 设置画布大小
          const dpr = wx.getSystemInfoSync().pixelRatio
          canvas.width = width * dpr
          canvas.height = height * dpr
          
          // 保存尺寸信息用于坐标转换
          this.canvasWidth = width
          this.canvasHeight = height
          this.dpr = dpr
          
          // 缩放上下文以匹配显示大小
          ctx.scale(dpr, dpr)
          
          // 绘制刮层
          ctx.fillStyle = '#CCCCCC'
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height)
          
          // 添加纹理
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#BBBBBB'
          ctx.lineWidth = 1
          
          // 斜线纹理
          const spacing = 10
          for(let i = 0; i < width + height; i += spacing) {
            ctx.beginPath()
            ctx.moveTo(i, 0)
            ctx.lineTo(0, i)
            ctx.stroke()
          }
        })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('初始化画布失败:', err)
    }
  },

  onTouchStart(e) {
    if (this.data.revealed || !this.ctx) return
    const touch = e.touches[0]
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    this.lastX = (touch.clientX - rect.left)
    this.lastY = (touch.clientY - rect.top)
    wx.vibrateShort({ type: 'light' })
  },

  onTouchMove(e) {
    if (this.data.revealed || !this.ctx) return
    
    const touch = e.touches[0]
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    const x = (touch.clientX - rect.left)
    const y = (touch.clientY - rect.top)
    
    const ctx = this.ctx
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out'
    
    // 绘制刮痕
    ctx.lineWidth = 40
    ctx.lineCap = 'round'
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round'
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(this.lastX, this.lastY)
    ctx.lineTo(x, y)
    ctx.stroke()
    
    this.lastX = x
    this.lastY = y
    
    // 检查刮开面积
    this.checkRevealProgress()
  },

  onTouchEnd() {
    if (this.data.revealed || !this.ctx) return
  },

  checkRevealProgress() {
    const ctx = this.ctx
    const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, this.canvasWidth, this.canvasHeight)
    const pixels = imageData.data
    let transparentPixels = 0
    
    // 每4个值表示一个像素的RGBA
    for (let i = 0; i < pixels.length; i += 4) {
      // 检查alpha通道
      if (pixels[i + 3] < 128) {
        transparentPixels++
      }
    }
    
    // 计算刮开百分比
    const totalPixels = (this.canvasWidth * this.canvasHeight)
    const percent = (transparentPixels / totalPixels) * 100
    
    // 刮开30%后显示结果
    if (percent > 30 && !this.data.revealed) {
      this.revealResult()
    }
  },

  async revealResult() {
    if (this.data.revealed) return

    try {
      const { hasWon } = await scratchService.play(this.data.id)
      
      this.setData({
        hasWon,
        revealed: true
      })

      if (hasWon) {
        wx.vibrateShort({ type: 'medium' })
      }

    } catch (err) {
      console.error('游戏失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '游戏失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
    }
  },

  // ... 其他方法保持不变 ...
})
```

_**Assistant**_

让我们针对安卓设备进行特殊处理。主要问题可能是坐标计算和画布尺寸的问题。

```javascript:pages/scratch/play/index.js
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    card: null,
    loading: true,
    hasWon: false,
    revealed: false,
    claiming: false,
    showPointsModal: false
  },

  async onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      await this.loadCardDetail(options.id)
      
      // 获取系统信息
      this.systemInfo = wx.getSystemInfoSync()
      this.isAndroid = this.systemInfo.platform === 'android'
      
      // 延迟初始化画布
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.initCanvas()
      }, 500)
    }
  },

  async initCanvas() {
    const query = wx.createSelectorQuery()
    query.select('#scratchCanvas')
      .boundingClientRect()
      .exec(res => {
        if (!res[0]) return
        
        // 保存画布位置信息
        this.canvasRect = res[0]
        
        // 初始化画布节点
        query.select('#scratchCanvas')
          .fields({ node: true, size: true })
          .exec(async res => {
            if (!res[0]?.node) return
            
            const canvas = res[0].node
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
            
            // 获取设备信息
            const dpr = this.systemInfo.pixelRatio
            const screenWidth = this.systemInfo.screenWidth
            
            // 设置画布尺寸
            const canvasWidth = this.canvasRect.width
            const canvasHeight = this.canvasRect.height
            
            canvas.width = canvasWidth * dpr
            canvas.height = canvasHeight * dpr
            
            // 保存画布信息
            this.canvas = canvas
            this.ctx = ctx
            this.canvasWidth = canvasWidth
            this.canvasHeight = canvasHeight
            this.dpr = dpr
            
            // 缩放上下文
            ctx.scale(dpr, dpr)
            
            // 绘制刮层
            ctx.fillStyle = '#CCCCCC'
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasWidth, canvasHeight)
            
            // 添加纹理
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#BBBBBB'
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.5
            
            // 斜线纹理
            const spacing = 6
            for(let i = -canvasHeight; i < canvasWidth + canvasHeight; i += spacing) {
              ctx.beginPath()
              ctx.moveTo(i, 0)
              ctx.lineTo(i + canvasHeight, canvasHeight)
              ctx.stroke()
            }
          })
      })
  },

  onTouchStart(e) {
    if (this.data.revealed || !this.ctx) return
    const touch = e.touches[0]
    const pos = this.convertTouchToCanvas(touch)
    this.lastX = pos.x
    this.lastY = pos.y
    wx.vibrateShort({ type: 'light' })
  },

  onTouchMove(e) {
    if (this.data.revealed || !this.ctx) return
    
    const touch = e.touches[0]
    const pos = this.convertTouchToCanvas(touch)
    
    const ctx = this.ctx
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out'
    
    // 绘制刮痕
    ctx.lineWidth = this.isAndroid ? 40 : 30  // 安卓设备增加刮痕宽度
    ctx.lineCap = 'round'
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round'
    
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(this.lastX, this.lastY)
    ctx.lineTo(pos.x, pos.y)
    ctx.stroke()
    
    this.lastX = pos.x
    this.lastY = pos.y
    
    // 检查刮开面积
    this.checkRevealProgress()
  },

  onTouchEnd() {
    if (this.data.revealed || !this.ctx) return
  },

  // 转换触摸坐标到画布坐标
  convertTouchToCanvas(touch) {
    if (!this.canvasRect) return { x: 0, y: 0 }
    
    let x = touch.clientX - this.canvasRect.left
    let y = touch.clientY - this.canvasRect.top
    
    // 安卓设备特殊处理
    if (this.isAndroid) {
      // 确保坐标在画布范围内
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, this.canvasWidth))
      y = Math.max(0, Math.min(y, this.canvasHeight))
    }
    
    return { x, y }
  },

  checkRevealProgress() {
    try {
      const ctx = this.ctx
      const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, this.canvasWidth, this.canvasHeight)
      const pixels = imageData.data
      let transparentPixels = 0
      
      // 安卓设备降低采样频率以提高性能
      const step = this.isAndroid ? 4 * 8 : 4 * 4
      
      for (let i = 0; i < pixels.length; i += step) {
        if (pixels[i + 3] < 128) {
          transparentPixels++
        }
      }
      
      const totalPixels = (this.canvasWidth * this.canvasHeight) / (step / 4)
      const percent = (transparentPixels / totalPixels) * 100
      
      // 安卓设备降低阈值
      const threshold = this.isAndroid ? 20 : 25
      if (percent > threshold && !this.data.revealed) {
        this.revealResult()
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('检查进度失败:', err)
    }
  },

  // ... 其他方法保持不变 ...
})
```

主要改进：
1. 添加了安卓设备的特殊处理
2. 使用两步初始化获取准确的画布位置
3. 增加了安卓设备的刮痕宽度
4. 优化了坐标转换逻辑
5. 降低了安卓设备的性能要求
6. 调整了刮开阈值

关键改动：
1. 保存系统信息和平台类型
2. 分两步获取画布信息
3. 针对安卓设备优化参数
4. 增加了坐标范围检查
5. 降低了采样频率
6. 调整了显示阈值

_**Assistant**_



让我们添加更多的容错处理和保底机制。

```javascript:pages/scratch/play/index.js
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    card: null,
    loading: true,
    hasWon: false,
    revealed: false,
    claiming: false,
    showPointsModal: false,
    canvasError: false,  // 添加画布错误状态
    retryCount: 0  // 添加重试计数
  },

  async onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      await this.loadCardDetail(options.id)
      
      // 获取系统信息
      try {
        this.systemInfo = wx.getSystemInfoSync()
        this.isAndroid = this.systemInfo.platform === 'android'
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('获取系统信息失败:', err)
        this.isAndroid = false
      }
      
      // 尝试初始化画布
      this.tryInitCanvas()
    }
  },

  // 尝试初始化画布，带重试机制
  tryInitCanvas(retryCount = 0) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.initCanvas().catch(err => {
        console.error('初始化画布失败:', err)
        if (retryCount < 3) {  // 最多重试3次
          this.tryInitCanvas(retryCount + 1)
        } else {
          this.setData({ canvasError: true })
          // 显示降级提示
          wx.showToast({
            title: '初始化失败，点击任意位置继续',
            icon: 'none',
            duration: 2000
          })
        }
      })
    }, 500 * (retryCount + 1))  // 递增延迟
  },

  async initCanvas() {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        const query = wx.createSelectorQuery()
        query.select('#scratchCanvas')
          .boundingClientRect()
          .exec(res => {
            if (!res[0]) {
              reject(new Error('获取画布位置失败'))
              return
            }
            
            this.canvasRect = res[0]
            
            query.select('#scratchCanvas')
              .fields({ node: true, size: true })
              .exec(async res => {
                if (!res[0]?.node) {
                  reject(new Error('获取画布节点失败'))
                  return
                }
                
                const canvas = res[0].node
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
                
                try {
                  // 设置画布尺寸
                  const dpr = this.systemInfo?.pixelRatio || 1
                  const canvasWidth = this.canvasRect.width
                  const canvasHeight = this.canvasRect.height
                  
                  canvas.width = canvasWidth * dpr
                  canvas.height = canvasHeight * dpr
                  
                  this.canvas = canvas
                  this.ctx = ctx
                  this.canvasWidth = canvasWidth
                  this.canvasHeight = canvasHeight
                  this.dpr = dpr
                  
                  ctx.scale(dpr, dpr)
                  
                  // 绘制刮层
                  this.drawScratchLayer()
                  resolve()
                } catch (err) {
                  reject(err)
                }
              })
          })
      } catch (err) {
        reject(err)
      }
    })
  },

  // 绘制刮层
  drawScratchLayer() {
    const ctx = this.ctx
    if (!ctx) return false

    try {
      // 绘制底色
      ctx.fillStyle = '#CCCCCC'
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.canvasWidth, this.canvasHeight)
      
      // 添加纹理
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#BBBBBB'
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.5
      
      // 斜线纹理
      const spacing = 6
      for(let i = -this.canvasHeight; i < this.canvasWidth + this.canvasHeight; i += spacing) {
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.moveTo(i, 0)
        ctx.lineTo(i + this.canvasHeight, this.canvasHeight)
        ctx.stroke()
      }
      return true
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('绘制刮层失败:', err)
      return false
    }
  },

  // 处理触摸事件
  onTouchStart(e) {
    // 如果画布出错，直接显示结果
    if (this.data.canvasError) {
      this.revealResult()
      return
    }

    if (this.data.revealed || !this.ctx) return
    const touch = e.touches[0]
    const pos = this.convertTouchToCanvas(touch)
    this.lastX = pos.x
    this.lastY = pos.y
    this.touchStartTime = Date.now()
    wx.vibrateShort({ type: 'light' })
  },

  onTouchMove(e) {
    if (this.data.revealed || !this.ctx) return
    
    try {
      const touch = e.touches[0]
      const pos = this.convertTouchToCanvas(touch)
      
      const ctx = this.ctx
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out'
      
      // 增加刮痕宽度
      ctx.lineWidth = this.isAndroid ? 50 : 40
      ctx.lineCap = 'round'
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round'
      
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(this.lastX, this.lastY)
      ctx.lineTo(pos.x, pos.y)
      ctx.stroke()
      
      this.lastX = pos.x
      this.lastY = pos.y
      
      this.checkRevealProgress()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('刮卡失败:', err)
      // 发生错误时直接显示结果
      this.revealResult()
    }
  },

  onTouchEnd(e) {
    // 检查是否为点击操作（短时间内没有移动）
    const touchDuration = Date.now() - (this.touchStartTime || 0)
    if (touchDuration < 200) {  // 200ms内的触摸认为是点击
      this.handleTap(e)
    }
  },

  // 处理点击事件
  handleTap(e) {
    if (this.data.revealed) return
    
    // 如果画布出错或者是点击操作，直接显示一块区域
    if (this.data.canvasError || !this.ctx) {
      this.revealResult()
      return
    }

    try {
      const touch = e.changedTouches[0]
      const pos = this.convertTouchToCanvas(touch)
      
      const ctx = this.ctx
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out'
      
      // 点击时刮开一个较大的圆形区域
      const radius = 60
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2)
      ctx.fill()
      
      this.checkRevealProgress()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('处理点击失败:', err)
      this.revealResult()
    }
  },

  // ... 其他方法保持不变 ...
})
```

主要改进：
1. 添加了画布初始化的重试机制
2. 增加了画布错误状态处理
3. 添加了降级方案（点击直接显示结果）
4. 增加了点击处理（可以点击刮开）
5. 增加了更多的错误捕获和处理
6. 增加了刮痕宽度
7. 优化了触摸事件处理

这样即使在画布初始化失败或刮卡过程出错的情况下，用户仍然可以：
1. 通过点击直接揭示结果
2. 获得操作反馈
3. 完成刮卡流程

```wxml:pages/scratch/play/index.wxml
    <view class="scratch-area" bindtap="startScratch">
      <!-- 结果显示 -->
      <view class="result {{hasWon ? 'win' : 'lose'}} {{revealed ? 'show' : ''}}">
        <text class="icon">{{hasWon ? '🎉' : '💔'}}</text>
        <text class="text">{{hasWon ? '恭喜获得' : '很遗憾'}}</text>
        <text class="reward" wx:if="{{hasWon}}">{{card.title}}</text>
      </view>
      
      <!-- 刮卡遮罩 -->
      <view class="scratch-mask {{isScratching ? 'scratching' : ''}}" wx:if="{{!revealed}}">
        <text>点击刮开</text>
      </view>
    </view>

    <!-- 领取按钮 -->
    <button 
      class="claim-btn"
      type="primary"
      loading="{{claiming}}"
      disabled="{{!hasWon || !revealed}}"
      bindtap="claimPrize"

</view>

<!-- 领取成功弹窗 -->
<modal
  visible="{{showPointsModal}}"
  title="领取成功"

  confirmText="查看任务"
  cancelText="关闭"
  bind:confirm="goToTasks"
  bind:cancel="hidePointsModal"
/>
```

```javascript:pages/scratch/play/index.js
const scratchService = require('../../../services/scratch')

Page({
  data: {
    id: '',
    card: null,
    loading: true,
    hasWon: false,
    revealed: false,
    claiming: false,
    showPointsModal: false,
    isScratching: false
  },

  async onLoad(options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.setData({ id: options.id })
      await this.loadCardDetail(options.id)
    }
  },

  async loadCardDetail(id) {
    try {
      this.setData({ loading: true })
      const { data: card } = await scratchService.getCardDetail(id)
      this.setData({ 
        card,
        loading: false
      })
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('加载失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '加载失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ loading: false })
    }
  },

  // 开始刮卡
  startScratch(e) {
    // 防止重复点击
    if (this.data.revealed || this.data.isScratching) return
    
    // 阻止事件冒泡
    e.stopPropagation()
    
    this.setData({ isScratching: true })
    
    // 添加震动反馈
    wx.vibrateShort({
      type: 'light',
      success: () => {
        // 震动成功后开始动画
        setTimeout(() => {
          this.showResult()
        }, 800)
      },
      fail: () => {
        // 震动失败也继续执行
        setTimeout(() => {
          this.showResult()
        }, 800)
      }
    })
  },

  // 显示结果
  async showResult() {
    if (this.data.revealed) return

    try {
      const { hasWon } = await scratchService.play(this.data.id)
      
      // 先完成动画
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 200))
      
      this.setData({
        hasWon,
        revealed: true,
        isScratching: false
      })

      if (hasWon) {
        // 中奖时添加额外震动反馈
        wx.vibrateShort({ type: 'medium' })
      }

    } catch (err) {
      console.error('游戏失败:', err)
      wx.showToast({
        title: '游戏失败',
        icon: 'error'
      })
      this.setData({ 
        isScratching: false,
        revealed: true  // 出错时也显示结果
      })
    }
  },

  // ... 其他方法保持不变 ...
})
```

```javascript:services/scratch.js
/**
 * 开始游戏
 */
async function play(cardId) {
  try {
    // 模拟请求
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100))

    // 直接返回中奖结果
    return {
      success: true,
      hasWon: true  // 设置为 true 表示必中奖
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('游戏失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 获取卡片详情
 */
async function getCardDetail(id) {
  try {
    // 模拟请求
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100))

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        id,
        title: '观影券',
        description: '可用于观看任意一部电影',
        points: 100,
        probability: 1  // 100%中奖概率
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('获取详情失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

/**
 * 领取奖励
 */
async function claimPrize(cardId) {
  try {
    // 模拟请求
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100))

    return {
      success: true
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('领取失败:', err)
    throw err
  }
}

module.exports = {
  play,
  getCardDetail,
  claimPrize
}
```
